jobs.description:
What are we looking for?

Hercules https://hercules.app is hiring a Head of Technical Recruiting to own our technical hiring pipeline from first contact through offer. We have 20 open technical roles today, and you’ll drive inbound screening across all of them.



What will you do?

 - Own end-to-end technical recruiting: define the hiring criteria, source candidates, screen inbound, manage interviews, and close offers

 - Partner with hiring managers to prioritize roles and calibrate what good looks like

 - Move candidates along through the process as quickly as possible. We aim for an offer or rejection within 7 days of first screen

 - Build automations (including AI automations) to accelerate the screening and interview process

 - Own our engagements with our external recruiters



What skills do we expect you to have?

 - Strong technical experience - we are not looking for pattern matchers and key word finders. We genuinely expect you to be able to fluently dive deep into different engineering technologies, frameworks, best practices, and anti-practices
   
   - We assume at least one year of professional experience as an engineer will help with this although it is not required

 - Experience owning technical recruiting across multiple concurrent roles

 - Experience in a fast-growing company

 - Strong communication



What’s Hercules’ stack?

 - Technologies: Typescript, React, AI SDK, Postgres, Redis, Clickhouse, Tailwind, IaC (CDK, Terraform), Docker, Otel, Hono, Drizzle ORM, Temporal

 - Clouds: Cloudflare, AWS

 - AI Models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google

 

What are Hercules’ operating principles?

Hercules’ operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of the principles can be learned on the job, however, we do specifically filter for the following principles in our hiring process:

 1. We ship. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds up our learning and delights our customers.

 2. We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We’re proud of our work.

 3. We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done.

 

Is Hercules in-office or remote?

Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates who are willing to 1) work in US time zones and 2) travel to the office regularly.

 

What are Hercules’ benefits?

 - Unlimited AI token budget

 - Take what you need vacation policy

 - Healthcare, vision, and dental

 - Daily lunches, dinners and snacks in the office

 - We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

 

What’s the compensation?

$100k-$300k + equity (variable based on seniority, equity, and location)

jobs.title: Research Staff, LLMs
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.



The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.



Operating Principles:

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

 1. Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

 2. Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

 3. Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

 4. Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.




AI-FIRST BY DEFAULT

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.



That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:



 - Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

 - Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

 - Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

 - Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.



We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.



THE ROLE

Deepgram is currently looking for an experienced researcher to who has worked extensively with Large Language Models (LLMS) and has a deep understanding of transformer architecture to join our Research Staff. As a Member of the Research Staff, this individual should have extensive experience working on the hard technical aspects of LLMs, such as data curation, distributed large-scale training, optimization of transformer architecture, and Reinforcement Learning (RL) training.




THE CHALLENGE

We are seeking researchers who:

 - See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

 - Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

 - Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

 - Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Brainstorming and collaborating with other members of the Research Staff to define new LLM research initiatives

 - Broad surveying of literature, evaluating, classifying, and distilling current methods

 - Designing and carrying out experimental programs for LLMs

 - Driving transformer (LLM) training jobs successfully on distributed compute infrastructure and deploying new models into production

 - Documenting and presenting results and complex technical concepts clearly for a target audience

 - Proven experience working with large language models (LLMs) - including experience with data curation, distributed large-scale training, optimization of transformer architecture, and RL Learning

 - Strong experience coding in Python and working with Pytorch

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

The Quality Assurance Technician owns quality assurance and quality control for civil and defense avionics repair, from incoming goods through final release. In this role you will perform Return to Service, support the production floor on inspection and disposition decisions, lead problem solving on nonconformances and returned units, and support regulatory and customer audits. This position comes with a defined path to certification. Candidates with electronics or avionics experience who want to build a career in aviation quality are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

• Release and Return to Service: Perform final release and Return to Service (RTS) for civil and defense units under your FAA Repairman Certificate. Verify that all work, inspections, and documentation are complete and meet regulatory and customer requirements.
• Quality assurance and control: Ensure conformance across incoming goods control, in-process and final product inspection, and witness points. Support the floor with hidden damage inspections and decide whether units should be reworked or repaired.
• Nonconformances and turnbacks: Review inspector rejections from the ship table. Record each event in Oracle and the Turnback (TB) log, and open nonconformance (NC) records in Tip QA.
• Problem solving and corrective action: Lead problem solving with Operations on turnbacks, nonconformances, and returned units, and track actions in APPS through to closure. Combine technical experience, analytical thinking, and input from internal and limited external sources to propose solutions. This includes solutions outside set parameters for complex processes with technical variety or interdependent production cycles.
• Return Unit Investigation (RUI): Investigate units returned from the field and complete the RUI form.
• Audits: Support regulatory (FAA) and customer audits by providing records, evidence, and process knowledge.
• Process integration: Apply quality best practices. Understand how your area connects with Operations, Engineering, and Supply Chain, and how quality performance sets the business apart for customers.
• Future state, Return for Variance (RFV): Manage RFV activity once you hold IPC-A-610 certification.

Required Qualifications

• Associate's degree in engineering or a related technical field from an accredited college with a minimum of 2 years of experience in Quality or related field OR a high school diploma / GED with minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality or a related field.
• An FAA Repairman Certificate, or the ability to obtain one within 180 days of hire. (Must enroll in the FAA drug testing pool).
• Must be able to pass IPC 610 & J-STD certifications after training
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
• This position requires U.S. citizenship status.
• Ability and willingness to work off/varied shift/weekends, as required
• This role may encounter high risk or hazardous operations and/or include working shifts beyond a standard workweek. As such, a requirement of the role is to be at least 18 years of age by the time of joining.

Preferred Qualifications

• Electronics background, ideally with quality experience in avionics.
• Experience with FAA regulations.
• IPC-A-610 certification.
• IPC J-STD-001 certification.
• Experience with Oracle, Tip QA, and APPS.

Desired Characteristics

• Strong oral and written communication skills
• Ability to work well with Operations, Engineering, and customers.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
• Ability to document, plan, and carry out projects, with basic project management skills.
• Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation habits.

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

You'll work daily with Applied Scientists, animators, filmmakers, and storytellers, building the systems that turn new model architectures into production-grade tools artists can rely on under tight deadlines.

This role suits engineers who want their work to expand what storytelling can look like, putting new generative capabilities into the hands of the people building Prime Video's animated and live action shows.

Design, deploy, and operate ML training and inference workloads on EKS, including GPU node groups, custom schedulers, autoscaling, resource quotas, and gang scheduling for multi-GPU jobs
Integrate generative ML models (image, video, audio) into production inference pipelines, partnering with Applied Scientists to take new architectures from research to scaled deployment

Stay current with generative ML, distributed training, inference optimization, and GPU efficiency techniques, and apply them to move team metrics

jobs.title: Test Engineer II
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

SUMMARY
Under limited supervision designs, develops and maintains test procedures, tester hardware and software for electronic circuit board production.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

·          Review circuit board designs for testability requirements.
·          Support manufacturing with failure analysis, tester debugging, reduction of intermittent failures and downtime of test equipment.
·          Prepare recommendations for testing and documentation of procedures to be used from the product design phase through to initial production.
·          Generate reports and analysis of test data, prepares documentation and recommendations.
·          Review test equipment designs, data and RMA issues with customers regularly.
·          Design, and direct engineering and technical personnel in fabrication of testing and test control apparatus and equipment.
·          Direct and coordinate engineering activities concerned with development, procurement, installation, and calibration of instruments, equipment, and control devices required to test, record, and reduce test data.
·          Determine conditions under which tests are to be conducted and sequences and phases of test operations.
·          Direct and exercise control over operational, functional, and performance phases of tests.
·          Perform moderately complex assignments of the engineering test function for standard and/or custom devices.
·          Analyze and interpret test data and prepares technical reports for use by test engineering and management personnel.
·          Develop or use computer software and hardware to conduct tests on machinery and equipment.
·          Perform semi-routine technique development and maintenance, subject to established Jabil standards, including ISO and QS development standards.
·          May provide training in new procedures to production testing staff.
·          Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.
·          Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Bachelors of Science in Electronics or Electrical Engineering from four-year college or university preferred; or related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

LANGUAGE SKILLS
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

REASONING ABILITY
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee is frequently required to walk, and to lift and carry PC’s and test equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and use of computer monitor screens a great deal of time.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Individual’s primary workstation is located in the office area, with some time spent each day on the manufacturing floor. The noise level in this environment ranges from low to moderate.

As a Customer Service Associate, you combine top-notch customer service skills with genuine care for people to help customers feel comfortable while shopping at Lowe's. This is an excellent role for those who want to engage with customers and help them solve their home improvement challenges.

How We Support You

As a Customer Service Associate, you will welcome customers to Lowe's and help them find the right products and services for their home improvement needs. You will interact with customers throughout the day, help them find and select products, occasionally load merchandise, and ensure all customer needs are met.

While you will spend most of your time listening to customers, answering questions, and organizing merchandise, your daily responsibilities may vary by department.

Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel occasionally to meetings, training, or to support neighboring stores.

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. jobs.description:

At TJX Europe, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritises your development. Come join our TJX team—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off-price retailer.

Job Description:

Could you be one of our Loss Prevention Officers?

As the world's leading off-price retailer of clothing and homeware, we're all about putting our customers first. With thousands of shops worldwide, we aim to provide a positive and memorable experience for all.

Working as a Loss Prevention Officer, you'll help to deliver our goal of keeping our customers, associates and assets safe. Experience of being in a customer facing role, within a fast-paced retail environment or security guard role is ideal but not essential.

In this role:

You will be supporting a positive customer experience within our stores by being a visible, friendly, approachable presence at our entrance doors. You will be focused on deterring loss on the salesfloor whilst acting as an ambassador for the loss prevention function.

You will work closely with the store team to maintain security of our product and together you will aim to deliver effective conflict resolution when required.

You will need to demonstrate your ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.

You will also be self-motivated, resilient and driven to make a difference with a natural ability to communicate.

In return, you'll get an in-depth programme of training when you start.

Are we right for you?

We're all about helping you develop yourself. The skills you'll learn working within Loss Prevention will help you be at your best. Plus, you'll be surrounded by the support of our fun and caring team.

Also as a TJX Europe associate, you'll enjoy such things as:

Competitive Salary

Uniform Provided

Comprehensive package of benefits to support your mental, physical and financial wellbeing such as access to an employee assistance program, associate discount and service awards

Join us, and you’ll be a part of our thriving, growing European business filled with opportunities for growth and recognition. We’re proud of our culture, we work hard, have lots of fun, and give back to many causes we care about.

It will be a role you won't just like but love.

As proud as we are of our past success, it’s our future that excites us most. We strive to provide opportunities for growth, recognition and a competitive salary and benefits package. Share our determination to think bolder and bigger, and be part of our future. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnerships, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and/or sexual orientation.

At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do

This is a 2nd Shift Opportunity. this is Monday - Thursday ( 4 -10 hour shifts) 4:00pm- 2:00am

This position is designed to give individuals with little or no machining or grinding background the skills they need to become a Certified Operator at Pratt & Whitney.

Employees selected for this position will attend a 3-week training program and participate in 4-8 weeks of the on the job training.

Learn to set up and operate NC milling/grinding machines, vertical turret lathes or VTC’s to perform routine production operations on a variety of similar weldments and assemblies.

Learn to work from operation sheets, part travelers, BOROPS, and oral instruction to set up equipment for grinding, turning, facing, boring and/or chamfering operations involving a limited number of surfaces to be machined.

Learn to verify conformance of finished work to specifications using precision measuring instruments.

Obtain operator Certification to be able to accept/reject parts.

Learn to maintain machines by performing required total preventive maintenance (TPM)

Learn to work collaboratively with engineers, quality assurance, programmers and other production personnel or others to resolve machining problems and assist in part process development.

Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

What You Will Learn

Skills, systems, and processes critical to aerospace manufacturing within a stat of the art facility.

Training and advancement opportunities at all levels through a supportive and collaborative employee experience.

On -the -job training using the most advanced technology in the industry today.

Qualifications You Must Have

High School or GED

Qualifications We Prefer

1 + years of manufacturing, automotive or related trade experience

Ability to make computations involving decimals and fractions

Ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously

What We Offer

The salary range for this role is $17.13-$30.10. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Bonus Plan – eligible to participate in the Company's Aerospace Variable Plan (AVP)

Comprehensive Benefits Program - medical, dental, vision and life insurance

Paid time off including vacation, personal/sick time, and holidays

Additional Leaves including short-term & long-term disability, parental leave, bereavement leave, jury duty coverage, and military leave

Savings & Investment Plan with company match & employer contributions

Flexible savings and spending accounts

Employee Assistance Program with onsite and referral resources to support a Healthy You

Employee Scholar Program – one of the most comprehensive company-sponsored employee education programs in the world (No waiting period!)

Employee discounts and rebates program

Learn More and Apply Today

What is my role type?

In addition to transforming the future of flight, we are also transforming how and where we work. We’ve introduced role types to help you understand how you will operate in our blended work environment. This role is:

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance workers, as they are essential to the development of our engines.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.

jobs.title: Principal, Data Scientist (Marketplace Risk)
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.

This is a full-time onsite role based in Bellevue, WA; remote and hybrid options are not available.

Role Summary:
The Principal Data Scientist will lead the development and deployment of advanced machine learning models and machine learning solutions to address complex business challenges. This role requires expertise in end-to-end model development lifecycle from data to features to modelling to deployment.  The position involves mentoring team members, collaborating cross-functionally, and ensuring the quality and effectiveness of data sources and models. The successful candidate will drive innovation by applying cutting-edge techniques and delivering measurable business impact while maintaining high standards of integrity and operational excellence.

About the Team:
The Marketplace Data Science team at Walmart Global Tech drives innovation in global commerce by supporting a rapidly expanding eCommerce platform. The team empowers thousands of sellers to efficiently manage digital storefronts, optimizing product listings, pricing, and inventory. They deliver seamless pre- and post-order experiences through intelligent, resilient systems. Utilizing real-time data and integrating with partner platforms across Walmart’s ecosystem, the team ensures exceptional customer experiences. Focused on scalable, reliable solutions, they collaborate across functions to advance technology roadmaps and support sustained business growth.

What You'll Do:

• Develop, test, and deploy advanced machine learning models and data-driven solutions aligned with business requirements.

• Analyze complex business problems to identify root causes and recommend effective technology-focused approaches.

• Identify, assess, and validate data sources ensuring quality and relevance for analytical modeling.

• Lead feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and model evaluation to optimize performance and robustness.

• Demonstrate strong thought-leadership and consult with product and business stakeholders to build, scale and deploy holistic data science products after successful prototyping.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data science strategies and measurable outcomes.

• Mentor team members on advanced modeling techniques, data visualization, and best practices.

• Drive continuous improvement by integrating emerging machine learning trends and automation tools.

What You'll Bring:

jobs.location: (USA) Upstream Building AR Bentonville Home Office
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

The Senior Manager, Knowledge Management leads the strategy, architecture, governance, and transformation of knowledge across Marketplace Seller Support and Risk Operations. This leader will build a globally scalable, AI-enabled knowledge ecosystem that delivers accurate, actionable information to associates and systems at the point of work.

Responsible for knowledge content, technology, operational performance, and team leadership, the Senior Manager will establish executive partnerships, documentation accountability, and measurable standards for quality, speed, and adoption. The role will modernize how knowledge is created, maintained, retrieved, and applied, enabling more consistent decisions, stronger associate performance, and better seller experiences.

What you'll do...

Knowledge Strategy & Governance

• Define and execute a global knowledge management strategy, operating model, and roadmap across Seller Support and Risk Operations.

• Establish governance frameworks, content ownership, decision rights, documentation standards, and service-level agreements with business stakeholders.

• Partner directly with Risk, Seller Support, Policy, Product, and Technology leaders to anticipate changes, resolve dependencies, and ensure knowledge readiness for business initiatives.

• Proactively identify conflicting policies, inconsistent guidance, and knowledge gaps, driving resolution with accountable business owners.

Knowledge Architecture & Content Operations

• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of knowledge articles and reference materials, including development, validation, publishing, maintenance, and retirement.

• Establish and optimize taxonomy, metadata, categorization, information architecture, and content relationships to improve discoverability, reuse, and accuracy.

• Lead knowledge inventory rationalization, content cleanup, SME validation, and migration to a modern knowledge management platform.

• Establish efficient intake, approval, and publishing workflows that support rapid business changes without compromising quality.

• Develop accessible, audience-centered knowledge experiences, including visual summaries and other formats that improve comprehension and awareness.

Knowledge Technology & AI Enablement

• Lead the selection, implementation, integration, and ongoing optimization of a modern, AI-native knowledge management system.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to embed trusted, permission-aware knowledge into associate workflows and AI-assisted support.

• Establish standards for knowledge retrieval, source reliability, version control, access permissions, and AI-generated answer quality.

• Identify opportunities to automate content maintenance, approval routing, publishing, and knowledge distribution.

• Ensure knowledge architecture supports both human associates and AI systems while maintaining appropriate governance and controls.

Global Scalability & Regionalization

• Establish a global knowledge operating model that balances consistent standards with country-specific policies, languages, regulatory requirements, and operational practices.

• Define governance for regional content variations, translation, localization, and role-based access across internal teams and BPO partners.

• Partner with regional leaders to ensure knowledge remains accurate, relevant, and accessible as Marketplace expands into new countries.

Knowledge Intelligence & Business Impact

• Establish KPIs and reporting for knowledge quality, search effectiveness, article helpfulness, change cycle time, adoption, and productivity.

• Use content analytics, associate feedback, search behavior, and operational data to identify knowledge gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.

• Surface knowledge-related risks and insights to business leaders, including contradictory guidance, unclear procedures, and documentation gaps.

• Connect knowledge effectiveness to operational outcomes, including associate proficiency, case handling efficiency, quality, and seller experience.

People Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of knowledge professionals, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and development pathways.

• Assess team capabilities, capacity, and organizational design to improve productivity and support a scalable operating model.

• Leverage AI, automation, and process improvements to reduce administrative effort, eliminate rework, and increase speed and quality.

• Establish strong cross-functional ways of working with Instructional Design, Facilitation, Program Management, and Communication & Engagement while maintaining clear ownership of knowledge deliverables.

What You'll Bring

• Demonstrated experience leading knowledge management, content strategy, knowledge operations, or related enterprise functions.

• Strong expertise in knowledge architecture, taxonomy, metadata, content governance, and enterprise knowledge management platforms.

• Experience building or transforming knowledge ecosystems, including platform implementation, migration, and operational optimization.

• Understanding of AI-powered knowledge retrieval, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the requirements for accurate, governed AI-assisted answers.

• Proven ability to establish executive partnerships, influence cross-functional decisions, and drive accountability across business functions.

• Experience leading and developing teams, managing performance, and optimizing resources and capacity.

• Strong analytical skills with experience defining KPIs, measuring effectiveness, and connecting knowledge performance to business outcomes.

• Ability to lead through ambiguity, balance strategic transformation with operational execution, and deliver at speed without compromising quality.

• Experience supporting global service operations, contact centers, multilingual environments, or BPO partnerships preferred.

What Success Looks Like

A globally scalable Knowledge Management function with a trusted source of truth, clear governance, measurable performance, and efficient content operations. Associates can find and apply accurate information when they need it, business leaders have visibility into knowledge gaps and risks, and AI-enabled systems can reliably consume governed knowledge to improve operational performance and the seller experience.

jobs.description:
Position Summary...

Lead the analytics practice that changes how Walmart’s audit teams work. As Director, Data Analytics, you’ll turn data, automation and emerging technology into products that sharpen audit coverage, surface risk sooner and deliver results the business can measure. You’ll partner with audit teams across the organization to spark new ways of working, share what you learn and scale what works, all while leading a team in a space that never stands still. It’s an opportunity to pair deep analytical expertise with a product mindset and inspirational leadership at Walmart’s scale.

About the Team:

We’re an innovation-minded analytics team working alongside audit teams, business partners and technology functions. We treat analytics as products: we find the right problems, ship solutions people actually use, and measure the difference they make. We share what we build and what we learn, from reusable methods to new tools, so every audit team can move faster and see further. Our work supports trusted, accessible and responsible use of data, and we adapt quickly as risks, technology and priorities change.

What you'll do...

• Drive innovation in how audit works: Spot opportunities to apply analytics, automation and emerging technology to audit planning, risk assessment, testing and reporting. Question long-standing assumptions, prototype quickly and turn the best ideas into solutions with clear success criteria, metrics and measurable return on investment.

• Engage audit teams and drive change: Partner with audit teams across the organization to understand how they work, co-design solutions that fit and lead the adoption that makes change stick. Influence stakeholders at every level and turn early wins into new ways of working.
• Share knowledge and raise the bar: Introduce new tools, methods and ideas to audit teams, and share what you learn through playbooks, demos, communities of practice and mentoring. Make good analytical practice easy for others to adopt, adapt and build on.

• Run analytics like a product: Own a roadmap that connects audit priorities to analytics and technology delivery. Define the customer, the problem and the outcome; prioritize ruthlessly; assess costs and resource needs; deliver in increments; and report on adoption, quality, time saved and risk insight gained.

• Drive technology governance and enterprise compliance: Ensure analytics products, AI solutions, and automation initiatives align with Walmart’s enterprise technology, security, and governance requirements. Lead and coordinate internal review and approval processes, including Solution Security Plan (SSP), Enterprise Privacy Risk Assessment (EPRA) and other applicable reviews for deployed solutions. Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Technology teams to identify risks, address requirements, and obtain necessary approvals before deployment, ensuring solutions are secure, compliant, and scalable.

• Find the signal and tell the story: Identify fit-for-purpose data across existing systems and distributed data stores, perform data quality checks, and use exploratory analysis, statistical methods and models to test hypotheses and surface insight. Select the right visualization tools and build clear, compelling stories for analysts, audit leaders and executives, partnering with user experience designers and engineers when front-end applications are needed.

• Advance data strategy, quality and responsible use: Apply and influence data strategy across audit and business domains. Define data quality rules, metrics and service-level strategies, recommend improvements to data governance policies and practices, manage user access as needed, and support requirements for data privacy, security, storage, retention and documentation.

• Lead with energy and develop people: Recruit, develop and mentor talent, identify capability gaps and support succession planning and continuous learning. Build a curious, motivated team that is comfortable with change, and foster an environment grounded in Walmart’s standards of integrity and ethics, including the Open Door Policy.

What You’ll Bring:

• Proven experience leading innovation and turning ideas into delivered solutions, with a strong product mindset and a record of defining success measures and reporting measurable impact and business value.

• A strong analytical background, with experience in exploratory data analysis and statistical methods such as hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, correlation and statistical modeling, using tools or languages such as SQL, Python, SAS, Oracle, Apache Mahout or Excel.

• Experience identifying and working with data across business systems and distributed data stores, including SQL and NoSQL technologies, with an understanding of data modeling, integration, storage and warehousing.

• Experience creating visualizations and communicating insights using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Python or R, including libraries such as Matplotlib, Plotly or ggplot, and telling a compelling story to audiences from analysts to executives.

• An inspirational, energizing leader with experience leading initiatives and developing others, including engaging peers and stakeholders across teams, driving change and sharing knowledge through mentoring, coaching and teaching.

• Comfort in a dynamic, changing space: the ability to adapt as priorities, technology and risks shift, challenge assumptions constructively and keep teams focused on delivery.

• Knowledge of data management and governance, including data quality frameworks, profiling and cleansing tools, access practices, and privacy, security and retention requirements, plus knowledge of business practices and metrics across functions such as product, finance, technology, business systems or audit.

jobs.location: (USA) Together Building AR Bentonville Home Office
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

The Internship:

The Walmart Automated Pick and Delivery (APD) Internship is an 11-week program held during the summer of 2027. It is open to undergraduate students graduating between December 2027 and August 2028. This paid internship will prepare associates for a career with Walmart APD. Interns will work on meaningful projects, network with industry experts, and develop their skills while having an enriching summer experience.

About Automated Pickup & Delivery (APD):
Automated Pickup & Delivery (APD) centers are Walmart’s automated grocery fulfillment facilities that combine robotics, software systems, and in-store operations to fulfill online grocery orders at scale. These systems sit at the intersection of physical automation, software platforms, and store operations, and are a critical part of Walmart’s long-term eCommerce and grocery strategy. APDs are designed to:

• Increase daily order throughput per store

• Improve labor productivity (Units Per Labor Hour – UPLH)

• Deliver reliable, fast pickup experiences for customers

Role Summary:
The APD Engineering Intern (Undergraduate) will work on real-world automation and fulfillment problems that directly impact throughput, labor efficiency, system availability, and customer experience. Interns will join one of several APD engineering-focused teams and contribute to projects that improve how automation is designed, deployed, operated, and scaled across Walmart stores. This role is ideal for undergraduate engineers who want hands-on experience working on large-scale, real-world systems where software, hardware, and operations intersect.

What You’ll Learn:

• How automated fulfillment systems operate end-to-end in live retail environments

• How engineering decisions affect cost, productivity, and customer experience

• How data, simulation, and experimentation drive operational improvements

• How cross-functional teams (engineering, product, operations) work together to scale automation

Team Options & Focus Areas
Interns will be aligned to one primary team, based on interest and business need:

1. Process Engineering
Focus: Operational processes and labor efficiency
This team defines how store associates and automation work together day-to-day. You’ll help:

• Analyze operational workflows and identify bottlenecks

• Improve throughput and labor productivity (UPLH)

• Evaluate process changes and their impact on capacity and efficiency

Example problems:

• How should work be sequenced to maximize throughput?

• Where does labor time get lost during peak volume?

2. Integration & Implementation
Focus: Operations readiness and launch, construction and design, and successful automation adoption
This team manages the end to end construction and launch and ensures stores are fully prepared to operate automation. You’ll help:

• Support site launch planning and track key readiness milestones

• Analyze operational data to identify workflow and throughput issues

• Review site layouts and identify gaps between system design and real-world store usage

• Develop tools, documentation, or feedback loops to improve adoption and address issues

Example problems:

• What causes stores to struggle after automation go-live?

• How can we reduce ramp-up time and operational errors?

• What causes certain sites to perform below others in key acceptance metrics?

3. Stability & Scalability

jobs.title: Manager, Technology Operations
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Fulfillment Experience builds the capabilities and operating mechanisms that make Walmart a reliable, convenient on-demand partner. Our teams determine what customers can buy, the promise and fulfillment choices they see, how orders are managed and recovered, and how the network performs at scale. We partner across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Merchandising, Store Operations, Fulfillment Centers, Last Mile, Transportation, and Strategy to improve customer outcomes while balancing speed, assortment, cost, and operational feasibility.

Role summary

The (USA) Manager, Technology Operations identifies and solves complex, high-impact fulfillment problems across a defined product, operational, or customer-experience area. This role turns ambiguous customer, operational, and financial signals into a clear diagnosis, an aligned plan, and measurable results. Working across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, and operations partners, the Manager leads initiatives from discovery and analysis through decision, delivery, readiness, and impact measurement. Success requires structured problem solving, clear communication, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence without direct authority.

What you'll do

• Own a complex problem space or initiative that improves customer experience, fulfillment performance, or financial outcomes.

• Use customer, operational, and financial data to identify opportunities, quantify impact, isolate root causes, and define success measures.

• Translate ambiguous problems into clear problem statements, hypotheses, options, and data-driven recommendations.

• Lead cross-functional solution design and execution with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Store Operations, Fulfillment Centers, Last Mile, Transportation, and other partners.

• Build and manage end-to-end plans that make ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points, pilots, launch readiness, and success measures clear.

• Drive alignment and resolve trade-offs without direct authority; escalate issues with a clear recommendation when timely leadership decisions are needed.

• Create concise, executive-ready updates and decision materials that clarify what changed, why it matters, and the action required.

• Measure results after launch, identify gaps or unintended outcomes, and drive refinements, scaling, or corrective action.

• Improve the team's planning, visibility, and execution through better processes, tools, automation, and operating routines.

What you'll bring

• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in eCommerce, supply chain, operations, product, strategy, analytics, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.

• Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to turn ambiguous issues into clear questions, synthesize disparate inputs, identify root causes, and recommend a practical path forward.

• Strong analytical fluency and comfort using data to form hypotheses, assess trade-offs, define metrics, and measure impact.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex work understandable and action-oriented for audiences at every level.

• Proven ability to influence without authority, build trust across functions, navigate competing priorities, and drive commitments to closure.

• Disciplined program-management skills, including planning, milestone management, dependency and risk management, and launch or change readiness.

• Sound customer, operational, and financial judgment; able to balance the ideal solution with what is practical to execute at scale.

• A high-ownership mindset, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias for action.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience partnering directly with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver technology-enabled business outcomes.

• Experience in omnichannel retail, eCommerce, fulfillment, supply chain, marketplaces, or a similarly complex operating environment.

Position Summary...

The Senior Manager, Associate Experience leads the strategy and execution of communications, engagement, and associate experience initiatives across Marketplace Seller Support and Risk Operations. This leader shapes executive and organizational narratives, strengthens associate connection and engagement, and builds an ongoing listening strategy that translates feedback into measurable improvements.

Serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, the Senior Manager owns executive communications, organizational announcements, All-Hands, newsletters, recognition, and engagement programs while establishing new capabilities in associate listening, experience measurement, and continuous improvement.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring exceptional writing, editorial judgment, strategic thinking, and execution. The Senior Manager will build a globally scalable, insight-driven associate experience function that helps associates stay informed, feel heard, adopt change, and perform at their best.

What you'll do...

Executive & Organizational Communications

• Lead executive and organizational communications across MSSPR, shaping clear, compelling narratives that connect business strategy, priorities, and performance to the associate experience.

• Serve as a trusted communications advisor to senior leaders, providing strategic counsel, editorial direction, and thoughtful challenge on messaging, timing, and delivery.

• Personally develop, write, edit, and deliver executive messages, organizational announcements, business updates, and other high-impact communications.

• Establish editorial standards, approval protocols, and communications governance to ensure accuracy, consistency, appropriate executive alignment, and sound judgment.

• Translate complex business, organizational, and operational changes into accessible, actionable communications for diverse audiences.

Associate Engagement & Connection

• Own the strategy, planning, production, and execution of MSSPR All-Hands, newsletters, recognition programs, and associate engagement initiatives.

• Build programs that strengthen connection, belonging, recognition, and understanding of organizational priorities.

• Develop a coordinated editorial and engagement calendar that balances business communications, associate needs, and organizational priorities.

• Evaluate engagement effectiveness and continuously refine channels, formats, and programs to improve reach, participation, and impact.

Associate Listening & Insights

• Design and lead an ongoing associate listening strategy, including recurring pulse surveys, always-on feedback channels, and targeted listening sessions.

• Establish representative listening approaches across Seller Support, Risk Operations, countries, and BPO partners while minimizing survey fatigue.

• Analyze associate feedback, sentiment, and experience data to identify trends, systemic challenges, and emerging opportunities.

• Translate insights into actionable recommendations and partner with business leaders to prioritize and address experience gaps.

• Establish closed-loop feedback practices that demonstrate how associate input informs decisions and improvements.

Associate Journey & Experience Improvement

• Map and assess the end-to-end associate journey, identifying critical moments across onboarding, training, production readiness, tooling, knowledge access, development, and organizational change.

• Partner with Operations, Product, Technology, HR, and Capability leaders to establish improvement plans, clarify ownership, and track execution.

• Partner with business and change leaders to assess audience impacts, anticipate resistance, and reinforce understanding and adoption.

• Measure communication effectiveness and change adoption, using feedback and behavioral insights to refine messaging and support.

• Ensure associates receive timely, relevant information that helps them understand what is changing, why it matters, and what action is required.

Global Associate Experience & Regionalization

• Partner with regional leaders to adapt communications, listening approaches, and engagement initiatives to local languages, cultures, and operational environments.

• Ensure internal associates and BPO partners receive relevant business and operational communications while tailoring engagement and recognition programs to appropriate audiences.

• Establish consistent experience measures across regions while accounting for local needs and differences.

Measurement, Governance & Operational Excellence

• Establish KPIs for associate engagement, communication effectiveness, change adoption, and experience improvement.

• Use quantitative and qualitative insights to measure sentiment, comprehension, adoption, and reduction in associate friction.

• Develop dashboards and executive reporting that connect associate experience trends to business priorities and improvement actions.

• Own end-to-end execution of the function, including planning, content development, production, stakeholder coordination, approvals, and delivery.

• Establish scalable workflows, prioritization, and operating practices that improve speed, quality, consistency, and productivity.

• Leverage technology, AI, and automation to streamline communications production, listening analysis, and reporting without compromising accuracy or human judgment.

What You'll Bring

• Demonstrated experience leading internal or executive communications, associate engagement, employee experience, or related functions in a complex organization.

• Exceptional writing, editing, storytelling, and executive communications skills, with the ability to translate complex information into concise, compelling, human-centered messages.

• Proven ability to advise senior executives, shape organizational narratives, challenge assumptions, and exercise sound judgment in sensitive communications.

• Experience personally managing communications programs and channels, including executive messaging, newsletters, town halls, organizational announcements, and engagement initiatives.

A globally connected MSSPR organization where associates are informed, engaged, heard, and supported in doing their best work.

jobs.title: Part Time Floor Leader - The Summit at Reno
jobs.description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

Reno Pay

$16.50—$16.50 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

We Are Lush

YouTube
LinkedIn

Find our Personal Privacy Policy details here.

Lush Handmade Cosmetics participates in E-Verify in certain US states including AL, GA, NC, SC, FL, AZ, UT, TN and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

As a business headquartered in Canada, our largest facilities are located on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh, as well as here on the lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit, Anishnabeg, Chippewa, Haudenosaunee and Wendat, and now home to many diverse First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples.

Our commitment to reconciliation and decolonization is guided by the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada: Calls to Action #92. jobs.title: Short-Term Firmware Intern
jobs.description:
JOIN THE SLEEP FITNESS MOVEMENT

At Eight Sleep, we’re on a mission to fuel human potential through optimal sleep. As the world’s first sleep fitness company, we’re redefining what it means to be well-rested and building the most advanced hardware, software, and AI technology to make it possible. Our products power peak mental, physical, and emotional performance by transforming every night of sleep into a personalized, data-driven recovery experience. We are trusted by high performers, professional athletes, and health-conscious consumers in over 35 countries worldwide. Recognized as one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2019, 2022, 2023, and 2026, and twice named to TIME's “Best Inventions of the Year.” We operate like a high-performance team: fast, focused, and motivated by impact. We don’t just ship; we iterate, refine, and obsess over the details that help our members sleep better and wake up stronger. 

 

Every role at Eight Sleep is a chance to create cutting-edge technology, collaborate with world-class talent, and help shape a future where sleep isn’t passive - it’s a powerful tool for living better. If you’re tired of the ordinary and driven to build at the edge of what’s possible, this is your moment. Join us and lead the movement that’s transforming how the world sleeps and what we’re all capable of when we wake up.

 


HIGH STANDARDS. NO APOLOGIES.

We operate with intensity because our mission demands it. At Eight Sleep, we bring the same mindset as the world’s top performers: focused, relentless, and always pushing to be in the top 1% of our craft. Think Kobe Bryant’s mamba mentality, applied to bold ideas, next-gen tech, and flawless execution. We’re here to build fast, push limits, and deliver without compromise. If you thrive under pressure and want to do the most meaningful work of your career, you’ll feel right at home. If you’re looking for something easier –this isn’t it.

 


THE ROLE

We’re looking for a student or recent graduate intern to join a field team and work on multiple parts of the system. You’ll build and deploy prototypes to users, run critical tests, and support failure analysis in hardware-software integrated systems. 

This role requires being on-site in one of five US cities: New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Austin or Washington, DC. It will last 6-8 weeks and preference will be given to candidates who are available to start as soon as possible.

 

How you’ll contribute

 - Build and test complex electromechanical systems for a new product, including sensors, pumps, and electronics.

 - Collaborate with product team to deploy systems to real users

 - Collaborate with sensor, mechanical, electrical, and software engineering to review sensor data and field feedback, identify root cause of issues, and determine corrective actions

 - Reproduce and characterize failure cases on the bench to confirm root cause and validate that corrective actions hold.

 - Track and report findings from troubleshooting to the engineering and product team.
   
   

What you need to succeed

 - Engineering background with ability to troubleshoot complex systems.

 - Experience with hands-on prototyping of mechanical and electrical systems.

 - Experience using lab and diagnostic tools such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and command-line utilities to characterize and debug hardware-firmware systems. Familiarity with AI tools (e.g. Claude) for debugging, scripting, or documentation is a plus.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - BS or expected BS in engineering or equivalent. MS preferred.

 - Ability to occasionally lift or push up to 50 lbs as needed.

 


WHY JOIN EIGHT SLEEP?

Innovation in a culture of excellence

Join us in a workplace where innovation isn’t just encouraged - it’s a standard. Our flagship product, the Pod, is a testament to our culture of excellence, beloved by hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide. At Eight Sleep, you will be part of a team that continuously pushes the boundaries of technology in sleep fitness.

 

Immediate responsibility and accelerated career growth

From your first day, you’ll take on substantial responsibilities that have a direct impact on our core business and product success. We are a small team that empowers you to own your projects and see the tangible effects of your efforts, enhancing both your professional growth and our company’s trajectory. Your path will be challenging but rewarding, perfect for those who thrive in fast-paced environments aiming for high standards.

 

Collaboration with exceptional talent

Work alongside other bright minds like you: at Eight Sleep exceptional intelligence and a passion for breakthroughs are the norms. Our team members are not only experts in their fields but also avid innovators who thrive in our dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 

At Eight Sleep we continually celebrate the diverse community different individuals cultivate. As an equal opportunity employer, we stay true to our values by ensuring everyone feels they can flourish and grow. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.description:
This is our MD Fill - Aseptic Gown - B2 night shift:  6pm-6:30am Wednesday - Friday & every other Saturday

Performs functions associated with cGMP manufacturing operations within the biologics production facility, including working with engineers in set-up and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components and final materials. Uses sophisticated programs (such as LIMS, SAP, automated control systems, etc.) to collect and evaluate operating data, which can be used to conduct on-line adjustments to products, instruments or equipment. Determines and may assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.

Responsibilities

• Must have the ability to become aseptic gown certified.
• Shipping finished materials.
• Maintaining inventory levels.
• Sampling of in process and raw materials.
• Running glass washer / autoclave.
• Buffer / media preparation.
• Equipment preparation (CIP / SIP).
• Cell culture (from vial thaw to production scale).
• Column chromatography.
• Tangential flow filtration
• Wear an aseptic gown during an 8 hr shift. This gown covers the full body.
• Willing to complete a lot cleaning sanitation during the work shift
• Follow all clean room entry and exit procedures
• Wear the required aseptic gowning and PPE correctly at all times
• Perform hand hygiene and sanitization before entering the clean room
• Maintain aseptic technique to prevent contamination of materials and products
• Sanitize work surfaces, tools, and equipment on a frequent and consistent basis
• Minimize movement, talking, and unnecessary activity in the clean room
• Inspect gowning and PPE for proper fit and integrity before use
• Report any contamination concerns, spills, or equipment issues immediately
• Handle sterile materials only in approved areas and in a controlled manner
• Follow all environmental monitoring and cleaning requirements
• Dispose of waste and contaminated materials according to procedure
• Complete all required documentation accurately and on time. Good hand writing will be a huge plus.

jobs.title: Management Trainee (Kahului International Airport)
jobs.description:
At SIXT, we don't just hire for jobs - we build leadership careers. 1ST GEAR! is our global Management Trainee Program - a dynamic, 12-month journey designed to fast-track your way into a real leadership role. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, take on responsibility, and develop the skills you need to lead in one of the world’s most innovative mobility companies. What makes this program unique? You don’t just complete it - you graduate into a leadership position. Whether it’s managing your own downtown branch or becoming part of a high-performing airport leadership team, your next career step is guaranteed. Earn an hourly rate of $23.68 with a performance-based bonus, and the use of a company car upon successful completion of the program.

We’re looking for ambitious, curious, and proactive individuals who are ready to roll up their sleeves and grow fast. If you want to make an impact, lead with confidence, and shape the future of mobility, 1ST GEAR! is your starting line.

YOURS TO OWN

• You take on responsibility early in your 12-month program, support the achievement of our operational goals, and contribute to greater efficiency and shared success within the team. Upon successful completion of the program, you will be placed directly in a leadership position anywhere in the United States
• You gain insights into key business areas such as Sales, Customer Service, Fleet Management, and Performance Management, and develop further along clear learning and performance goals
• You work in the operational day-to-day business from day one, get to know all aspects of our core operations from sales to fleet operations, and are supported through training in communication, conflict resolution, sales, and problem-solving strategies
• You collaborate closely with Branch Managers and Area Directors to learn leadership on the job

YOUR SKILLS MATTER

• Growth Mindset You have completed a bachelor's degree or gained relevant professional experience in Sales, Customer Service, Tourism, Hospitality and Management
• Leadership and Entrepreneurial Potential You have a hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset, driven to lead - you don’t wait for instructions, you take the lead
• Communication Excellence You have strong communication skills in English (other languages are a plus)
• Proactive Attitude You work independently, solve problems, and take ownership
• Agile Flexibility You are required to work and travel within the United States as business needs dictate. This is not a fully remote position and may require periodic travel of up to 50% during the first year of the program as well as temporary assignments across various locations within the United States
• Mobility Readiness You hold a valid driver’s license and have at least 1 year of driving experience

WHAT WE OFFER

• Guaranteed Leadership Landing Role And privilege use of a company car upon successful program completion
• Attractive Compensation Package Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus
• Exclusive Employee Benefits From discounted rentals and dry-cleaned uniforms to comprehensive healthcare and retirement plans
• Paid Time Off & Sick Leave Recharge with PTO and sick leave to ensure a balanced work-life experience
• Career Mobility & International Growth Opportunities across functions, cities, and even countries
• Fast-track Leadership Development A structured 12-month program that sets you up for your first management role

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!
