jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst - 15 Month Contract
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As a Strategic Finance Analyst, you’ll help 1Password make informed decisions about how it invests in growth. You’ll partner with Marketing and Finance leaders to own marketing operating expenses (opex) and headcount forecasting, explain performance against plan, and improve recurring reporting and planning processes. This is a 15-month fixed-term contract with the opportunity to contribute to thoughtful, data-informed growth across the company.

 

How we’re using AI today
On the Finance team, we’re using AI to drive productivity, scale insight, and deliver better decision-making across 1Password. AI helps us move faster and sharpen our thinking, from summarizing context and pressure-testing assumptions to turning complex inputs into clear executive-level narratives. We bring AI into our work thoughtfully, improving repeatable workflows while staying accountable for the accuracy, confidentiality, and controls behind every output, creating space to focus on judgement, strategic partnership, and meaningful business outcomes.

 

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

 

What we're looking for:

 - 4+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), strategic finance or business analytics, with a preference for SaaS or subscription technology companies

 - Experience owning operating expense and headcount forecasts against budget, including program spend and vendor costs, with a preference for marketing

 - Experience running a monthly close, forecast and variance cycle, including reconciling actuals and writing variance commentary for an executive audience

 - A track record of using AI tools and automation to improve a finance process, such as automating a recurring report, drafting variance commentary or standardizing a forecast template

 - Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including maintaining and rolling forward financial models built by others

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting analysis to Marketing budget owners

 - Ability to learn new metrics, models and processes quickly and work independently against set priorities
   

Bonus points for:

 - Experience building AI agents or automated workflows for a finance team

 - Experience with NetSuite, Anaplan, ChartHop, Salesforce or Hex

 - Experience with marketing spend analytics such as cost per pipeline, CAC and payback


What you can expect:

 - Own the marketing opex forecast, budget tracking and quarterly reforecast, including program and campaign spend, and explain each variance to budget with its driver so Finance and Marketing leaders can act on it

 - Own the marketing headcount forecast, tracking hires, open roles and departures against plan to show their impact on marketing opex

 - Reconcile monthly marketing opex and headcount actuals to the general ledger and the headcount system, and turn the results into the marketing sections of the monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBR and QBR), including tables, charts and a draft narrative for an executive audience

 - Streamline recurring forecasting and reporting work, such as actuals feeds, budget owner updates and variance commentary, so each monthly cycle takes less manual effort

 - Prepare materials for reviews with Marketing budget owners, attend alongside the Director, record decisions and complete the follow-up analysis

 - Support marketing spend efficiency reporting, including cost per pipeline, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and payback, to inform marketing investment decisions

 - Contribute to process improvement projects across GTM finance with the Strategic Finance team, bringing the same approach to shared forecasting and reporting workflows

 - Document each recurring process so the work hands off cleanly at the end of the term

 
 

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $107,000 USD and $150,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

 

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $84,000 CAD and $118,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.





Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. The way we bring those values to life every day is guided by our 1Password Behaviors for Success https://1password.com/blog/how-to-interview-with-confidence-at-1password.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

🏝 Generous PTO policy - accrue 2.08 days per month
💖 Company-wide wellness days (1 per quarter)

You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

jobs.title: Robot Service Technician Shift Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.


THE TEAM

The Robotics Technician Team works closely with PI’s fleet operations and engineering teams to maintain the robotic platforms that power our AI research. The team is collaborative, fast-moving, and deeply technical — and this role is a direct partner to operations and engineers building and improving the systems you’ll maintain.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Robot Service Technician Shift Lead manages a team of technicians, leads shift operations, and is accountable for upholding performance metrics and quality related to robot fleet service and maintenance. The shift lead ensures complete visibility of assignments across the technician team, maintains total robot tracking accuracy, guarantees clean robot service and maintenance ticket documentation at handoffs, and ensures robot issues requiring management or engineering support are escalated within the same shift.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Shift Preparation & Launch
   
   - Lead daily standup; align on priorities and key blockers alongside fleet team leadership.
   
   - Verify site staffing and assign specific duties to team members prior to robot handling.
   
   - Ensure all necessary parts, kits, and equipment are staged for the shift.

 - Active Shift Management
   
   - Manage ticket queue: assign, and adjust priorities
   
   - Maintain up-to-date ticket statuses, detailing assigned owner, root cause, and next steps for down robots.
   
   - Handle real-time escalations in fleet crew within the shift to prevent unnecessary delays.
   
   - Monitor workload across sites and reallocate personnel as needed to maintain balance.
   
   - Serve as primary floor contact for engineering and operations teams.
   
   - Enforce rest and full meal break compliance for all shift members
   
   - Review technician work on robot issue tickets and preventative maintenance to ensure high quality of work
   
   - Direct shift-level events (audits, bring-ups, moves), managing meal logistics, attendance, and move-protocol custody tracking.
   
   - Manage logistics for robots, parts, and equipment across the shift: tracking real-time robot locations, transfers, scene/site moves, and swaps. Maintain stocked arms, spares, and tools aligned with operational needs.

 - Shift Closeout & Handoff
   
   - Deliver a detailed written handoff covering completed tasks, ongoing work, blockers, and moved robot locations.
   
   - Publish end-of-shift updates in the public channel.
   
   - Provide a quick direct status check-in before departing.

 - Team Leadership & Administration
   
   - Act as front-line point of contact for schedule compliance, attendance, and break standards.
   
   - Review and approve Rippling timecards prior to payroll cutoffs; address missed punches, verify approved overtime, and report schedule discrepancies before approval.
   
   - Escalate to the Robot Lab Manager and fleet leadership for support when there are gaps in shift coverage.
   
   - Manage PTO coverage requests and ensure balance in shift coverage
   
   - Onboard and train incoming technicians following the closeout guide and RST expectations documentation.
   
   - Performance management of technicians
   
   - Conduct interviews for technician hiring


WHAT WE HOPE YOU'LL BRING

 - Relevant Technician Skillset: Hands-on experience in electrical and mechanical maintenance, automation, or robotics

 - Leadership: Experience leading / managing a team of technicians

 - Detail Oriented: Attention to detail to screen for high quality work from the team

 - Strong Communication: Ability to provide clear verbal and non-verbal communication to technicians within your team and to fleet team leadership.


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience using Linear ticketing system

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Statistical Programming
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Immunome is a clinical-stage targeted oncology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies. We are advancing an innovative portfolio of therapeutics, supported by a leadership team with deep experience in the design, development, and commercialization of cutting-edge therapies, including antibody-drug conjugates. Our pipeline includes varegacestat, an investigational gamma secretase inhibitor for which an NDA has been accepted by the U.S. FDA; IM-1021, a clinical-stage ROR1 ADC; IM-1617, a clinical-stage solid tumor ADC; and IM-3050, a clinical-stage FAP-targeted radioligand therapy. We are also advancing a broad portfolio of early-stage ADCs pursuing undisclosed solid tumor targets.

Position Overview

The Senior Manager, Statistical Programming will provide planning, execution, and quality of SAS programming deliverables supporting the analysis and reporting of clinical trial results. This role also ensures the submission-readiness of study data packages in accordance with CDISC standards, applicable regulatory guidance, and internal standards. This role will also collaborate cross-functionally with Biostatistics, Data Management, Clinical Development, and others to contribute to the development and continuous improvement of statistical programming standards, processes, tools and infrastructure within the Biometrics department.

Responsibilities

• Lead statistical programming activities for 1 or 2 assigned clinical studies, ensuring high-quality deliverables across the full study lifecycle.

• Develop and/or view programming specifications based on the Statistical Analysis Plan and oversee the creation, validation, and delivery of CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets, TLFs, Define.xml, and reviewer guides.

• Provide hands-on SAS programming support for key analyses, data exploration, ad hoc requests, and internal or regulatory deliverables, as needed.

• Manage study programming timelines, coordinate dependencies, proactively identify risks, and ensure alignment with cross-functional study plans and key milestones.

• Collaborate closely with Biostatistics, Data Management, Clinical Operations, and Safety teams to review requirements, refine specifications, and resolve data or programming issues.

• Review Data Management Plans, case report forms, data transfer specifications, external/vendor data specifications, and validation-related documentation to ensure data quality and downstream programming readiness.

jobs.title: Director of Strategy
jobs.description:
Started by Families, Focused on Students

Developing Scholars in East San José

We were founded by families in East San José who wanted stronger academics and more support for their children. Alpha is a free, TK-12 public charter school system on a mission to prepare the next generation of leaders in East San José.

Alpha Public Schools is a network of four public charter schools committed to providing access to an outstanding education. Join us as we prepare students in TK-12th grade for success in college and career.

Who we are:

Alpha Public Schools is a public charter school network of four schools educating approximately 1,900 scholars in east San Jose. Guided by the belief that our students belong in college, we ensure safe, inclusive, and student-centered learning environments to help our students thrive. What sets us apart is the very thing that makes us who we are – our community. Alpha was founded by a group of mothers on the eastside of San Jose who sought better educational opportunities for their students. We maintain a strong connection to our community and engage families in a collaborative approach to offer a holistic education to our students.

Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, the Director of Strategy is a cross-functional leader responsible for shaping and realizing Alpha Public Schools’ strategy. This individual drives high-impact initiatives that align with our mission and strategic goals while overseeing the organization’s multi-year and annual strategic planning processes. This role requires frequent collaboration with key stakeholders to ensure alignment and success. By providing a strategic lens and effective project management, the Director of Strategy supports the organization in achieving its long-term objectives while fostering innovation and continuous improvement.

We are seeking passionate individuals who embody Alpha’s mission, vision and core beliefs: leaders who believe that all students can learn, that our scholars belong in college, and that student growth is a reflection of the teacher’s practice. We are looking for leaders who are reflective in their practice and are willing to engage in conversations around educational equity. We're committed to finding leaders who value and amplify the diverse experiences of our staff and scholars and their families, and who care deeply about addressing the inequities that exist in education.

The salary range for this role is $106,496 - $119,988.

What you’ll do…

Strategic Planning and Alignment

• Facilitate the development and implementation of Alpha’s multi-year strategic plan and annual organizational priorities, engaging key stakeholders throughout.

• Facilitate the annual planning process, guided by our multi-year strategy and key accountability metrics, and in collaboration with the Schools, Finance, Talent, and Operations teams.

• Oversee the development of each school’s Local Control and Accountability Plan (LCAP), ensuring a high-quality work product that is aligned to Alpha’s strategy and meets the requirements of the state and our authorizers.

• Develop and refine systems, processes, and frameworks to support efficient project execution and alignment with the Alpha’s mission, vision, and strategy.

• Collaborate with the Director of Data & Analytics to ensure leaders and staff have access to the data they need to execute on our strategy

Project Leadership and Execution

• Lead the successful planning, development, and completion of major organizational projects, including initiatives aligned to Alpha’s multi-year strategy as well as other special projects.

• Drive progress on assigned projects by facilitating planning meetings, drafting implementation plans, monitoring progress, and preparing reports for leadership and stakeholders.

• Develop and implement strategic solutions to address challenges or surprises, working closely with the Chief Strategy Officer to execute resolutions effectively.

• During renewal years, project manage Alpha’s charter renewal process, including oversight of petition development, facilitation of the renewals core team, and leader preparation.

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to foster collaboration, engagement, and cross-functional alignment.

• Act as a liaison between various teams, ensuring alignment and clear communication across departments.

• Prepare and present updates on project progress, outcomes, and next steps to leadership and other key stakeholders.

Organizational Improvement and Innovation

• Identify opportunities for operational and organizational improvements and lead efforts to implement innovative solutions.

• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of projects, applying lessons learned to future initiatives.

• Support accountability efforts by staying informed of relevant regulations and working with Alpha’s executive leadership team to ensure adherence.

You possess…

• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in leading, planning, and implementing strategic initiatives and/or projects in a complex organization. You have the ability to develop and/or utilize tools and resources, including technology, that provide structure and process for successful project implementation.

• Adaptive project management skills. You thrive on navigating change by providing structure while remaining flexible to accommodate the unknown factors that arise during a project. You learn from discovery by assessing the outcomes of the decisions taken in previous stages and adjusting accordingly.

• Analytical skills. You have the ability to identify relevant data and analyze it to innovatively problem-solve and make decisions. You can detect patterns, interpret data, and find the relevant narrative based on the multiple factors and options available to you.

• Experience working in K-12 education, ideally in a charter management organization, and/or experience working in management consulting or a related field.

You stand out by being…

• Highly organized and self-directed. You take initiative and organize your work with the information provided, and take responsibility for your learning. You are able to organize yourself and your stakeholders in the way that best meets the needs of the outcome.

• A cross-functional utility player. Your skills span multiple functions. You value working collaboratively, and with colleagues of various functional expertise. You can support and/or motivate a team with different skill sets, responsibilities and approaches to work together to perform specific tasks.

• Effective in translating plans into action. You embrace change and effectively manage up, down, and laterally to bring about that change. You know that plans and strategy only matter if they are implemented. Effective change management is a way of being for you: you thrive on working with stakeholders to bring new plans and ideas to life, and building the conditions for sustained behavior change.

• An emotionally intelligent collaborator. You bring others together in service of a stronger outcome, and you contribute to a healthy team culture. You are an effective verbal and written communicator who is tuned in to the needs and perspectives of your stakeholders, and you are effective in bringing people together across lines of difference.

Join our team…

To apply for this position, please submit a resume online.

Alpha Public Schools is a network of four public charter schools founded by a group of East San José mothers dedicated to helping transform their community. We have a strong growth mindset – as individuals, as an organization, and on behalf of our students and families. We want to be better tomorrow than we are today.

As an equal opportunity employer, we hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status or disability. We are strongly committed to hiring a diverse and multicultural staff and encourage applications from traditionally under-represented backgrounds.

Salary is competitive and compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package.

About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models, from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings, helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We have led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we are building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

Zuora and Workday now sell Zuora Billing and Revenue together under one Workday contract. This role makes that partnership win technically in Workday Financial Management (FINS) accounts, both net-new and existing. You will work alongside Workday and Zuora AEs, Workday FINS specialists and value consultants, and you will own the technical win.

In this role, you will:

• Own the technical win on Workday FINS opportunities: discovery, architecture, objection handling, and clear positioning of Zuora against Workday-native billing and revenue options

You bring:

jobs.title: Senior Media Buyer
jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE THIS ROLE IS FOR OVERSEAS APPLICATION, NON -U.S. ONLY. NO DOMESTIC (U.S.) APPLICATIONS WILL BE CONSIDERED.

About the role:

Senior Media Buyer in the User Acquisition team, reporting to the Director of User Acquisition. Meta is our biggest acquisition channel, with a seven-figure monthly budget.

We are growing the UA team and adding a media buyer who will lead a project we care about a lot: building the best buying automation in the industry. We want the machine to handle the whole routine, pacing, scaling, kills, alerts, reporting, so the team's time goes to tests and growth. Meta first; the same approach then extends to our other channels.

You will buy on Meta alongside the team, and on top of that you own the automation roadmap. You map the routine, decide what to automate next, write the spec, and an engineer builds it. You test what comes back on the live account, accept it or send it back, and keep the logic current when the market or the offer changes. As the routine moves to the machine, you and the team put that time into experiments: new structures, audiences, offers, landing pages, creative angles.

What You'll Be Responsible For:

• Buy on Meta as part of the team: run your share of campaigns against ROI and spend targets.
• Lead the automation project: budget pacing, scaling and kill rules, alerts, reporting. Turn each piece of the routine into a clear spec for the engineer, test the result, and flag it when a rule breaks.
• Help the team adopt the tools: show how they work, take their feedback, improve them.
• Run a steady pipeline of tests: campaign structure, bidding, audiences, offers, landing pages. Set them up so the result is readable, and tell a real effect from noise.
• Answer day-to-day data questions yourself in Mixpanel and with AI tools, and work with our analytics team on deeper research.
• Keep tracking healthy: pixel, CAPI, event setup, attribution, and how Meta numbers match our internal data.

What You'll Need To Have:

• 4+ years of hands-on Meta buying with large budgets (ideally $500K+/month), subscription or DTC e-commerce.
• You have taken a buying account from manual to automated before, and you can show what was built and what it replaced. You know what is possible with the Marketing API, rules engines (Meta rules, Revealbot, Madgicx), scripts and AI agents. Coding is not required: you write specs an engineer can build from without guessing.
• Comfortable with Mixpanel or similar product analytics and with spreadsheets. You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) every day for analysis and routine tasks.
• You think in ROI, CPA and LTV, and you can explain why a number moved.
• Fluent English. Russian is a strong plus.
• Nice to have: experience with other channels (TikTok, Snapchat, AppLovin, Google), landing page and funnel A/B testing, launching new markets, reading a script (Python, JS) and seeing what it does

What We'll Love About You

• You like running your own project: give you a goal, and you come back with a plan, results and the next ideas.
• You bring your own ideas every week, without waiting for a task.
• When you see the same task done by hand twice, you start thinking about how to automate it.

What You'll Love About Us

• Competitive base compensation
• Bonus program
• Paid Time Off and Work From Home
• A fun, creative and energetic work environment

About Scentbird

Scentbird inspires fragrance lovers to go beyond the ordinary and sample scents that evoke passion, confidence, and the unknown. Our mission is to revolutionize the way we perfume by bringing the ultimate fragrance playground right to your fingertips and offering a digital subscription service that lets members choose from over 500+ designer perfumes each month.

About the Brands:

• Scentbird: The easiest way for fragrance lovers to discover, try, and buy their favorite scented products without a commitment
• Deck of Scarlet: Deck of Scarlet is on a mission to break the clean category, redefining what clean fragrances should smell like. Composed entirely of vegan, cruelty-free ingredients, our fragrances bridge the gap between the clean and luxury categories, using the highest eau de parfum concentrations housed in sculptural, eye-catching bottles. You shouldn’t have to choose between being luxe and refined, or clean and vegan—now, you don’t have to.
• Confessions Of A Rebel: We were born in 2018, holding fast to the idea that the fragrance industry was in dire need of a change. When we looked around, all we saw was a sea of sameness: outdated archetypes of femininity and masculinity paired with unrelatable images of luxury that we had no say in. In truth, we are complex in ways that cannot be contained in the traditional heteronormative stereotypes, existing beyond the binary with raw, unfiltered voices that deserve to be heard.
• Goodhabit: Enriched with a blend of essential oils, Goodhabit’s clean, vegan, cruelty-free fragrances act as bottled intentions you set free with each mist. Our scents are designed to help you align with the good habits you’re building, while working to enhance and boost your mood. Inhale, exhale, and let the good energy flow through you.
• Sanctuary: Created for those who care about the fate of our planets, Sanctuary offers fragrance for a better future. Our clean, community-driven fragrances are inspired by endangered species and their habitats, each aimed at raising money and awareness for the preservation of their namesake.

jobs.title: IAM Enablement Analyst
jobs.description:
The IAM Enablement Analyst exists to make Identity and Access Management (IAM) services easier to understand, navigate, and use. The role will support user research and journey mapping, translate customer needs into actionable requirements, and help design and maintain a persona-based IAM portal that brings together self-service, guidance, and support options. This person will partner with IAM product, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to improve content, simplify experiences, and monitor adoption and user feedback. Through these activities, the analyst will help increase self-service, reduce friction, and create a more consistent customer experience across IAM offerings.

Take the next step in your career with an organization that strategically invests in the long-term health of the company, its technology, and its people. The AbbVie Business Technology Solutions (BTS) team shapes the digital transformation necessary for our treatments to positively impact patients' lives. In this role, you will help turn IAM capabilities into intuitive, customer-centered experiences by improving user journeys, expanding self-service, and contributing to the development of a unified IAM portal.

About Our Team

This position is part of AbbVie's Information Security & Risk Management (ISRM) team within Business Technology Solutions and reports to the Associate Director, Customer Enablement & Innovation. The Identity & Access Management (IAM) team is responsible for the development, implementation, and oversight of the organization's IAM strategy, helping provide secure, efficient, and compliant access to systems and data. The team supports capabilities including User Lifecycle Management, Privileged Account Management, Directory Services, MFA, Federation and SSO, Access Certifications, Role Based Access Control, External Identity Management, and Application and System Integration. We put our partners in a position to succeed by providing the knowledge, tools, experiences, and support they need to use IAM services effectively while managing risk.

Responsibilities

• Gathering and documenting user needs through interviews, surveys, feedback channels, support trends, and direct observation of IAM experiences.
• Mapping current and future user journeys for common IAM activities, identifying friction points, handoffs, content gaps, and opportunities for simplification.
• Translating customer, business, security, and operational needs into clear user stories, use cases, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and prioritized backlog items.
• Supporting the design, development, testing, launch, and continuous improvement of a persona-based IAM portal that provides a consistent entry point to self-service, guidance, tools, and support.
• Creating and maintaining clear user guides, FAQs, knowledge articles, process instructions, onboarding materials, communications, and other self-service content.
• Partnering with IAM product leads, engineering teams, operations, application teams, and other stakeholders to align portal content and user experiences with supported capabilities and product roadmaps.
• Helping define navigation, information architecture, content standards, and experience patterns that create a consistent end-to-end experience across IAM offerings.
• Coordinating usability testing, pilot activities, and feedback reviews, then documenting findings and recommending practical experience improvements.
• Supporting customer education, demonstrations, office hours, and adoption activities for IAM services and new self-service capabilities.
• Tracking adoption, portal usage, customer feedback, self-service effectiveness, and other defined experience measures, and preparing concise insights for team leaders and stakeholders.
• Identifying recurring user issues and process gaps, recommending automation or self-service opportunities, and helping validate whether implemented changes improve the experience.
• Ensuring portal content, user guidance, and enablement materials follow applicable accessibility, security, privacy, compliance, and documentation standards.
• Maintaining organized work items, decisions, requirements, dependencies, risks, and status updates for assigned enablement and portal initiatives.
• Contributing to a culture of customer focus, collaboration, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree with relevant professional experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Experience in business analysis, user experience, product support, customer enablement, digital experience, process improvement, information security, or a related technology discipline.
• Experience gathering requirements and translating user or business needs into clear documentation, user stories, process flows, or actionable work items.
• Experience creating user-facing documentation, knowledge content, communications, training materials, or self-service guidance.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear, customer-friendly language.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across product, engineering, operations, support, security, and business teams.
• Customer-centered mindset with an interest in simplifying complex processes and improving how people interact with technology.
• Ability to use feedback and data to identify patterns, recommend improvements, and measure results.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with IAM concepts such as Identity Governance and Administration, Role Based Access Control, MFA, SSO and Federation, Privileged Access Management, access certifications, or identity lifecycle management.
• Experience contributing to a portal, intranet, knowledge base, digital product, or self-service experience.
• Experience with user research, journey mapping, personas, usability testing, information architecture, service design, or content design.
• Experience working with Agile product teams and tools used for backlogs, requirements, prototyping, collaboration, analytics, or content management.
• Experience supporting adoption, office hours, demonstrations, training, or change communications.
• Familiarity with accessibility, regulated environments, risk management, or technology compliance expectations.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Product Policy Research & Measurement
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Product Policy team develops and implements policies that shape how OpenAI’s technology is built and used. We work with teams across the company to turn complex questions about AI’s benefits and risks into practical guidance for responsible research, product development, and deployment.

About the Role

We are hiring a senior applied scientist to study how AI affects people and society using OpenAI production data, experiments, and social science methods. This role sits at the intersection of applied social science, AI, and product policy. The scientist will own research from an ambiguous question through study design, data collection and analysis, methodological validation, and recommendations. Their work will inform product and policy decisions and, where appropriate, contribute to external publications. We are looking for a hands-on empirical social scientist with exceptional methodological judgment.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop and execute a research agenda on AI’s social impact, including effects on well-being, learning, social connection, trust, and human decision-making, in partnership with product and policy teams.

 - Own empirical studies end to end: define the question and estimand, choose the design, build the dataset, conduct the analysis, and explain what the evidence supports.

 - Analyze large-scale production and behavioral data, linking them to experiments, surveys, or external outcomes when appropriate to measure real-world effects.

 - Design randomized experiments and credible observational studies; test identification assumptions, quantify uncertainty, and distinguish association from causal effects.

 - Develop and validate measures of social outcomes, including human and LLM-assisted annotations; assess measurement error, subgroup performance, and drift.

 - Translate findings into concrete product and policy recommendations, with clear limits on causal interpretation, generalizability, and decision confidence.

 - Partner with Product Policy, Research, Product, Data Science, Engineering, UXR, Legal, and domain experts; contribute rigorous work to external publications when appropriate.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A PhD or equivalent research experience in sociology, political science, psychology, communication, computational social science, or a related empirical field, with demonstrated independent research ownership.

 - Deep expertise in research design, causal inference, experimentation, statistical analysis, and measurement, demonstrated through work you can personally explain and defend.

 - Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with experience independently constructing and analyzing complex behavioral datasets and producing reproducible research.

 - A record of research that informs consequential decisions about technology and people, with the judgment to identify both useful findings and unresolved uncertainty.

jobs.title: Corporate Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing-in-ground-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo - connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before.

Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production - and building the team to make it happen.


ROLE OVERVIEW

REGENT is scaling toward full production of its fully electric Seagliders, and that transformation is reshaping the company's risk profile in real time - new exposures, new geographies, new contractual relationships, and new insurance needs are surfacing faster than any existing framework was built to handle. As our Corporate Risk Analyst, you'll step directly into that moving picture: digging into REGENT's insurance programs, reviewing contracts and policy wordings line by line, and building out the risk identification and assessment processes that don't yet exist. Your work will directly shape how REGENT prepares for its 2027 insurance renewals, which means you'll be producing real analysis and real recommendations from your earliest days here, not easing in slowly.

Risk isn't yet a fully standalone function here, which means instead of stepping into a fixed structure, you'll have real input into how it takes shape as REGENT grows. This is a role for someone who thinks in frameworks but isn't afraid of a blank page, who can make a confident call with incomplete information, and who gets energy from building something foundational at a company reinventing how people move across water.

If you’re energized by working at the intersection of cutting-edge innovation and real-world impact, you’ll be in the right place - and we’d be thrilled to have you on the team!




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Map REGENT's Risk Landscape: You'll lead a thorough identification of risk across the business, building a clear, prioritized view of where REGENT is exposed as it scales toward full Seaglider production.

 - Close Coverage Gaps Before They're Expensive: You'll dig into insurance and commercial policy wordings line by line, flagging where coverage doesn't match real exposure before those gaps become costly surprises.

 - Drive Readiness for 2027 Renewals: You'll translate your risk analysis into a prioritized list of coverage gaps and recommended solutions that sets REGENT up for a strong 2027 insurance renewal cycle.

 - Evaluate Global Insurance Programs: You'll analyze and strategically review REGENT's insurance programs as the business grows in both scale and geography, helping ensure the program keeps pace with the company.

 - Own Contract and Policy Review: You'll review contracts for insurance requirements and cascade REGENT's own insurance requirements out to suppliers, making sure risk is properly addressed on both sides of every agreement.

 - Build the Framework From Scratch: You'll design risk frameworks, registers, and assessment processes where none currently exist, creating the scaffolding REGENT's risk function will run on as it matures.

 - Build REGENT's Broking Relationships: You'll establish and grow relationships with the broking industry on REGENT's behalf, becoming a trusted voice representing REGENT's risk profile externally.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Real Risk Management Experience: You've worked in risk management, compliance programs, or assurance-based roles and can move straight into analysis with minimal ramp-up time.

 - Insurance Program Fluency: You've analyzed and strategically reviewed global insurance programs and understand how to evaluate where a program is strong and where it's exposed.

 - Contract and Policy Review: You're comfortable reviewing inbound contract requirements for insurance, and also translating policy wordings into clear, actionable guidance internally and outbound.

 - Sharp Eye for Coverage Gaps: You've gone line by line through insurance or commercial policy wordings in a real job and can point to times you caught a gap between stated coverage and actual exposure before it became a problem.

 - Builder, Not Just Maintainer: You've built a risk framework, register, or assessment process from a blank page before, not only maintained one someone else designed.

 - Rigorous and Detail-Oriented: You're analytical, organized, and genuinely energized by managing large volumes of competing data without letting anything slip through the cracks.

 - Energized by Novel Problems: You're excited by the idea of assessing risk for a genuinely new kind of vehicle and not just applying a playbook built for conventional aircraft, vessels or manufacturing process.

 - Comfortable Shaping Something New: You see the chance to help define a risk function as it forms as an opportunity rather than a gap, and you want your fingerprints on how it's built.




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Collaborative Team Player: You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You communicate effectively and collaborate with engineers, stakeholders, and other cross-functional teams to align on goals and move projects forward. You bring people together, ensuring that everyone is on the same page and moving towards a shared vision.

 - Creative Problem Solver: You thrive on tackling complex challenges and finding innovative solutions. You don't just patch issues - you improve processes, anticipate downstream impacts, and help turn one-off fixes into scalable solutions that raise the bar for future builds.

 - Adaptable & Agile: In a fast-paced, ever-evolving startup environment, you quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements. You approach challenges with a calm, resilient mindset, and know how to pivot and adjust your approach as needed, ensuring that progress continues without missing a beat.

 - Innovative Mindset: You’re driven by curiosity and a passion for technology. You’re passionate about driving continuous improvement, embracing new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and team performance.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation including a robust equity incentive plan.

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance - we cover 100% of your premiums.

 - 401(k) with company matching, so you can plan for the future.

 - Generous flexible time off, paid parental leave, and company-wide holiday breaks.

 - Relocation packages available for those moving to join our team.

 - Daily, free catered lunches

 - Learning & professional development opportunities

If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact.

Equal Opportunity Employer

REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Manager - Strategic Sourcing & Procurement
jobs.description:
About us

TeleTracking began with a simple but powerful belief that no one should wait for the care they need. More than a slogan, it’s a promise to continually improve healthcare.

TeleTracking builds groundbreaking technology incorporating deep clinical expertise. Our solutions are used in the nation’s largest healthcare systems and around the world to positively impact patients, families and communities.

What’s your contribution to the TeleTracking story?

When you chose to bring your passion and skills to helping achieve our purpose, you’ll be part of a team that understands that there’s a human life behind every data point.   Your skills, curiosity, and compassion—will help fuel our innovation and achieve the TeleTracking promise of revolutionizing modern healthcare.

About the role

The Manager - Strategic Sourcing & Procurement develops and implements strategic sourcing initiatives across direct and indirect purchasing categories as a hands-on individual contributor. Reporting to the Vice President of Finance, the Manager works closely with functional leaders and associates to meet the needs of internal and external customers and owns daily procurement execution and purchasing controls for U.S. and U.K. operations.

Procurement activities include software, consulting and professional services, marketing services, IT systems and services, office supplies, IT and office equipment, capital purchases, facilities services, direct materials, and Real-Time Locating System (RTLS) equipment for customer needs. The role combines strategic sourcing and supplier negotiations with procurement operations, inventory planning, and facilities management.

The Manager applies procurement experience, automation, and AI-assisted tools to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the procurement process, strengthen analysis, and streamline daily workflows.

What you will do

• Partner with functional leaders and budget owners to define purchasing requirements, align sourcing priorities with business plans, and execute sourcing strategies. This includes evaluating suppliers through competitive sourcing to assess total cost, quality, service, and business fit.

• Analyze spend across business units to identify savings, supplier consolidation, and service improvement opportunities. Reduce unmanaged spend and support sourcing needs across U.S. and U.K. operations.

• Collaborate with functional leaders to negotiate pricing, payment terms, payment frequency, delivery schedules, availability, service commitments, and renewal provisions. Work with functional leaders and associates to identify savings and supplier consolidation opportunities.

• Apply procurement experience and AI-assisted tools to model scenarios, analyze spend, strengthen negotiation strategies, and identify cost-reduction opportunities.

• Collaborate with Legal to establish appropriate contract terms and conditions. Coordinate IT, Security, Finance, and business reviews before supplier commitments are made.

• Manage supplier relationships and monitor responsiveness, cost, quality, flexibility, delivery, and financial condition to assess the ability to fulfill contract requirements.

• Resolve pricing, service, and delivery issues with business owners.

• Maintain accurate contract records, a renewal calendar, supplier key performance indicators (KPIs), and cost driver metrics to support timely renewals and supplier performance reviews.

• Oversee third-party sourcing and procurement negotiations and workflows, including Spendflo as applicable, while retaining responsibility for internal approvals, alignment with business needs, and compliance with company policies, budgets, privacy, security, and legal requirements.

• Manage procurement, inventory control, logistics, and distribution activities for RTLS equipment for clients. Monitor on-site inventory levels of RTLS hardware wristbands.

• Manage requisitions and create and update purchase orders in NetSuite for all U.S. and U.K. departments. Maintain vendor and purchasing records, track open commitments, and obtain approvals in accordance with company policy. Review open purchase orders and close remaining commitments when projects are complete, including purchase orders that have not been fully billed.

• Use Stampli to support invoice routing and work with business owners to resolve missing purchase orders, pricing discrepancies, and approval exceptions.

• Develop, maintain, and improve procurement policies and procedures. Enforce approval requirements, budget alignment, and segregation of duties, and guide employees on purchasing processes.

• Develop methods and metrics to measure procurement results. Report spend, validated savings, cost avoidance, renewal exposure, and procurement performance to Finance and functional leaders.

• Provide purchasing and expense information to support accruals, reconciliations, and financial close, and identify and implement workflow improvements. Prepares journal entries for AP accruals and departmental allocations. Complete account reconciliations as required.

• Oversee daily site operations in Pittsburgh and ensure facility needs are met, working with service providers and contractors as required.

• Coordinate purchases of office supplies and equipment and maintain relationships with facilities vendors and contractors.

• Serve as backup for the company’s travel and expense (T&E) reimbursement function, including processing and administrative support in Concur. Backup duties include setting up departments, expense items, and audit rules in Concur and activating and deactivating corporate credit cards.

• Perform other job-related duties and special projects consistent with the scope and level of the position.

What we look for

• Seven or more years of progressive, hands-on experience in strategic sourcing and procurement, including independent ownership of sourcing projects, supplier negotiations, and daily procurement processes.

• Strong sourcing, negotiation, supplier evaluation, and contract review skills, with the ability to use AI-assisted tools to assess total cost and commercial risk.

• Ability to build trusted relationships across business units, communicate recommendations clearly, and influence decisions without direct authority.

• Strong analytical skills, Excel proficiency, and attention to detail, with the ability to turn spend data into actionable recommendations and measurable results.

• Ability to balance sourcing strategy with daily execution, prioritize competing requests, manage change, and improve processes with minimal supervision.

• Knowledge of procurement controls, approval workflows, AI-assisted sourcing and procurement tools, and the connection between purchasing, Accounts Payable, and financial close.

• A customer-focused approach, sound judgment, integrity, and accountability for results with a continuous improvement mindset.

Required systems experience

• Experience with NetSuite or a similar ERP system for purchase orders, vendor and purchasing records, open commitments, and procurement reporting.

• Experience with Stampli or a similar system for invoice approval workflows, exception resolution, and coordination with Accounts Payable.

Preferred experience

• Experience with Spendflo for software sourcing, renewals, negotiations, or procurement workflows.

• Experience with Concur for travel and expense processing, administration, audit rules, or corporate card controls.

• Experience in a technology or healthcare technology business and with U.S. and U.K. purchasing.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.

License or Certifications

• Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) or a comparable procurement certification is a plus.

Applicants must be willing to work at the company’s location in downtown Pittsburgh, PA, five days per week. They must also be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Benefits

• Employee Medical/dental/vision premiums paid 100% - family members without coverage Medical 100% - small cost for dependents on dental and vision, which start from day one!

• Life and AD&D

• Flexible Spending Accounts: Medical, Dependent Care, and Transportation

• 401 (k) Retirement Savings

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Military Paid Leave (up to 6 months of base salary while on military leave)

• Paid Time Off

• Paid parental leave

jobs.title: Director, Growth Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

The Director, Growth works alongside an assigned Team Principal/Growth Partner. This is an opportunity to partner directly with senior Flagship leadership, across Flagship functions, and GrowthCo teams to drive strategic and financial value creation across a portfolio of GrowthCo companies.  This role is the central node for drawing on Flagship capabilities and serves as the primary coordinator among Flagship resources.

You will serve as the primary analytical, operational, and strategic business partner to their assigned Team Principal/Growth Partner(s) and will be a trusted number two in a fast-paced, analytic, execution-focused environment who helps extend the Principal's reach across multiple assigned GrowthCos. You will work with the Team Principal to ensure execution of each company’s Value Maximization Strategy, follow Flagship governance, and ensure collaboration across and among the appropriate Flagship teams.

This role offers rare, full-spectrum exposure across the strategic, operational, scientific, financial, and commercial imperatives that define company-building in life sciences; making it an exceptional opportunity for an emerging executive who wants to see and shape what it takes to build breakthrough companies from the inside.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Management and Governance Alignment

• Serve as the Team Principal's right hand on day-to-day execution by keeping workstreams on track, flagging risks and issues early, anticipating what's next, and driving items to closure.

• Support the Team Principal in ensuring alignment and coordination with Flagship governance processes, including elevating decision points in a timely manner, preparing high-quality materials and ensuring proper follow up at key decision-making forums.

• Attend key meetings such as Growth Executive Sessions, Portfolio Decision Forums, Strategy Sessions, and Board Meetings to track and help advance key deliverables and ensure proper follow-up.

• Maintain a clear, current view of each GrowthCo's priorities and open items so the Team Principal is never caught flat-footed; serving as the connective tissue between Flagship and company teams between formal touchpoints

• Own the meeting-to-action loop: ensure that decisions made in governance forums translate into concrete next steps with clear owners and timelines, and that nothing falls through the cracks across a complex portfolio.

GrowthCo Partnership and Strategic Leadership

• Ensure that GrowthCos are working in alignment with their Value Maximization Plans, encompassing platform strategy, pipeline prioritization, partnership opportunities, financing strategy, and organizational development.

• Embed within GrowthCo leadership teams to build trusted relationships, understand evolving needs, and translate high-level strategies into concrete execution plans.

• Alongside the Team Principal, and relevant senior FSP/portfolio company executives, to co-lead analyses that inform critical strategic recommendations, including (in concert with relevant FSP functional team):

• Scientific development strategy and indication selection

• Competitive intelligence and market opportunity assessment

• Product development and pipeline strategy

• Financial modeling, valuation, and capital allocation analysis

• Partnership and business development strategy

• Serve as an early warning system for the Team Principal; identifying when a GrowthCo is drifting from its Value Maximization Strategy absorbing early signals from company teams before they become escalation-worthy issues.

• Help GrowthCo leadership teams think through the "Flagship angle" on key decisions (i.e. where sister company capabilities, portfolio relationships, or FSP resources could accelerate execution in ways the company might not see on its own).

Cross-Functional Coordination and Stakeholder Management

• Lead coordination across Flagship internal functions including Capital Solutions, Strategic Business Operations, Business Development, Finance, HR, Legal/IP, Real Estate, Communications, Digital, Pioneering Medicines, and the Office of the CEO

• Know when to convene versus when to inform. Develop sharp instincts for which cross-functional situations require active orchestration, and which just need a well-timed heads up, so the right people are engaged without creating unnecessary overhead.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships across functions proactively, not just when a GrowthCo need arises; so that when speed matters, the Crew Leader can move fast on behalf of the Team Principal without starting from scratch.

Team Integration and Portfolio Contribution

• Remain tightly connected to the Growth Team, particularly fellow crew leaders, to stay aligned with portfolio-wide standards, frameworks, and innovations.

• Contribute to shared knowledge bases, common operating models, benchmarking frameworks, and growth analytics that benefit the full GrowthCo portfolio.

• Participate selectively in cross-portfolio initiatives, informing and learning from ecosystem-wide best practices.

• Drive adoption of enterprise AI tools and best practices for operational scale, both within the Growth Team and across GrowthCos.

• Actively bring patterns and insights from their own GrowthCo portfolio back to the broader Growth Team so individual company learnings compound into portfolio-wide intelligence rather than staying siloed.

• Help newer or less-resourced GrowthCos benefit from the playbooks and relationships that more mature companies have developed, acting as a multiplier across the portfolio not just within their assigned companies.

Experience and Qualifications

Required

• Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in life sciences disciplines preferred, with related or equivalent work experience considered.

• 5+ years of experience at the intersection of life sciences and business

• Exposure to healthcare or life sciences — through prior roles, client work, or academic background — with interest in deepening operational and strategic experience in the sector.

• Demonstrated ability to understand financial models, interpret complex datasets, and translate quantitative analysis into clear strategic recommendations.

• Trusted, collaborative team player with high emotional intelligence, low ego, and a seasoned sense of curiosity.

• Experience working closely with senior company leadership, cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders.

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information for senior audiences and present financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.

• Proven ability to manage multiple high stakes workstreams with competing deadlines. High-level financial and scientific literacy sufficient to engage credibly across scientific, financing, and partnership discussions.

• Experience operating under pressure, figuring things out without a playbook, and recognizing moments where they can make challenging things happen.

• Confidence in knowing knowledge limitations, comfortable leaning on domain experts, asking the "obvious" question in the room, and building credibility through intellectual honesty.

Ideal Candidate Profile

• Fluency across finance, science, and strategy

• Effective time management, prioritization, and leadership skill

• Trusted right hand— operates with their authority and extends their reach across multiple companies

• Collaborative spirit and cross-functional effectiveness across Flagship and GrowthCo teams

• Demonstrated ownership and accountability; ability to see gaps and fill them without being asked, and who holds themselves accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.

• Comfortable being a smart generalist in a room full of specialists and able to engage credibly across disciplines without needing to be the domain expert, and confident enough to drive decisions forward even in areas of uncertainty.

• Deep intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward action and continuous improvement.

• Roll-up-your-sleeves; entrepreneurial attitude and comfort operating with minimal direction in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

• Strategic mindset with strong critical thinking and problem-solving ability

LOCATION:  Cambridge, MA. This position is full-time, on-site.

About Flagship Pioneering:

Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond.

What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet.
Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies.

Flagship Pioneering and our ecosystem companies are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

At Flagship, we recognize there is no perfect candidate. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. Experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your unique background.

Recruitment & Staffing Agencies: Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, “FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to FSP or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

#LI-TD1

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian - Jacksonville, FL
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As an Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including QPR training and access to free therapy or counseling

• Based on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

This is our MD Fill - Aseptic Gown - B2 night shift:  6pm-6:30am Wednesday - Friday & every other Saturday

Performs functions associated with cGMP manufacturing operations within the biologics production facility, including working with engineers in set-up and calibration tasks, as well as performing rework and quality testing related to the production of parts, components and final materials. Uses sophisticated programs (such as LIMS, SAP, automated control systems, etc.) to collect and evaluate operating data, which can be used to conduct on-line adjustments to products, instruments or equipment. Determines and may assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process.

Responsibilities

• Shipping finished materials.
• Maintaining inventory levels.

• Column chromatography.
• Tangential flow filtration
• Wear an aseptic gown during an 8 hr shift. This gown covers the full body.

• Follow all clean room entry and exit procedures

• Perform hand hygiene and sanitization before entering the clean room

• Sanitize work surfaces, tools, and equipment on a frequent and consistent basis
• Minimize movement, talking, and unnecessary activity in the clean room
• Inspect gowning and PPE for proper fit and integrity before use
• Report any contamination concerns, spills, or equipment issues immediately
• Handle sterile materials only in approved areas and in a controlled manner
• Follow all environmental monitoring and cleaning requirements
• Dispose of waste and contaminated materials according to procedure
• Complete all required documentation accurately and on time. Good hand writing will be a huge plus.
