jobs.description:
About the Job

Location: San Francisco Bay Area; Travel Required
Department: Real Estate
Reports to: Senior Director, Corporate Real Estate
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation: $155,000 – $180,000 + Bonus + Equity

About Ever

Ever is building the future of auto retail. As the first AI-native auto retailer, we are building the next $100B+ automotive business, starting with electric vehicles.

Based out of San Francisco and expanding nationwide, we are backed by leading investors and led by former tech & automotive professionals from Uber, Tesla, Rivian, Apple, Amazon, Carvana, J.P. Morgan, BCG, and more. After our recently completed Series B financing, we have raised around $200M in total equity and debt funding. We are growing rapidly and actively recruiting exceptional talent – to set a new frontier in the largest sector of the US retail economy.

Learn more about us at evercars.com.

About the Role

The Senior Manager will be Ever’s lead deal executor, taking sites from first tour through executed lease and hand-off to construction across multiple markets at once.

This role will work closely with co-founders, management, brokers, landlords, and legal counsel to secure locations that meet Ever’s operational needs, financial targets, and opening timelines. The ideal candidate is an exceptionally strong negotiator and deal manager with a proven track record of independently closing transactions. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, keeping many deals moving at once and making day-to-day decisions within approved parameters.

What You’ll Do

Site Sourcing and Evaluation

• Lead site requirements for retail, reconditioning, storage, and other operational uses.

• Source opportunities through brokers, landlords, developers, and direct outreach, and research trade areas, customer access, and competition for each site.

• Lead site tours and assess property suitability, including visibility, parking, vehicle circulation, building layout, power capacity, and expansion potential.

• Represent Ever with brokers, landlords, and municipalities as the day-to-day lead on assigned markets and transactions.

• Maintain an active, prioritized pipeline of sites and provide clear recommendations to co-founders and company leadership.

Negotiation and Deal Execution

• Lead negotiation of letters of intent, leases, amendments, and renewals within approved parameters, from first proposal through executed lease.

• Negotiate key business terms, including rent, TI allowances, free rent, term, options, use clauses, signage, and landlord work.

• Prepare site comparisons, occupancy cost analyses, project budgets, and approval materials, and present deal recommendations for approval.

• Coordinate with legal counsel and internal stakeholders to track business terms, resolve open items, and advance transactions.

• Manage transaction schedules, critical dates, dependencies, and documentation so deals close on time.

• Evaluate opportunities to improve occupancy costs, space utilization, and lease terms.

• Improve day-to-day deal tools, such as LOI templates, site scorecards, and critical-date trackers.

Due Diligence and Development Coordination

• Run zoning and permitted-use reviews, environmental assessments, property inspections, and utility and power capacity checks with qualified partners.

• Partner with construction, operations, and launch teams to evaluate feasibility, improvement costs, utility needs, and opening schedules.

• Identify site constraints early and escalate risks with practical recommendations.

• Track landlord deliverables, possession requirements, and key milestones through handoff to construction and operations.

What You Bring

• 7–10 years of commercial real estate experience in transactions, leasing, tenant-rep brokerage, or corporate real estate.

• A strong track record of personally negotiating and closing a high volume of LOIs and leases, ideally on the tenant or corporate-occupier side.

• Experience with retail, automotive, industrial, service, or other operationally complex properties.

• Deep knowledge of commercial lease economics, lease language, deal structures, and due diligence.

• Ability to run many concurrent deals with strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.

• Strong financial analysis skills, including proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Deep fluency working with AI platforms to produce analysis and reporting (e.g., Claude).

• Ability to interpret site plans, surveys, zoning information, and operational requirements.

• Clear communication, sound judgment, and effective negotiation and relationship-management skills.

• Willingness to travel approximately 30–40% of the time for market visits, site tours, and project meetings across California, the Pacific Northwest, Texas, and future markets.

• Bachelor’s degree in real estate, business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

• Experience supporting expansion across multiple states.

• Familiarity with automotive-use approvals, permitting, EV charging infrastructure, and utility coordination.

• Experience in industrial or flex leasing.

Compensation and Benefits

The Senior Manager, Corporate Real Estate position offers an annual base salary of $155,000–$180,000, a 15% target annual bonus, and stock options. Base salary within the range will depend on relevant experience, qualifications, and skills.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Head of Legal
jobs.description:
Location: New York City, San Francisco

Type: Full-time, In office

 


ABOUT THE COMPANY

Atlas is the concierge charge card for high-net-worth individuals and their companies. We pair 24/7 concierge access with no-preset-limit spending, giving members insider access to dining, luxury travel, and experiences that are otherwise impossible to get. We’ve crossed $1B in annualized transaction volume and are backed by Y Combinator, Elad Gil, O1 Advisors, Eric Schmidt, and other leading fintech and consumer investors. The team is lean, senior, and fast-moving, with experience across Apple, Robinhood, Rimowa, and more.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Head of Legal to run day-to-day legal work at Atlas. You’ll report directly to the founder and CEO and work closely with Finance, People, product and compliance colleagues.

This is a senior, hands-on lawyer role. You’ll draft and negotiate agreements yourself, manage outside counsel, and turn legal questions into clear recommendations and completed work. You’ll be the person who keeps priorities, deadlines and decisions moving across the business.

This role is a great fit if you enjoy being close to the business, taking responsibility for the details, and doing the work directly. It is not a role built around managing an internal legal team. There are no direct reports, and specialist outside lawyers remain an important part of how the work gets done.

We move quickly, expect a lot from ourselves, and value people who take ownership of their work and get things done well. You’ll need to distinguish what needs a careful review from what can move forward with a practical, well-understood solution.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO


LITIGATION & DISPUTES

 - Manage disputes and litigation with outside counsel, keeping the facts, deadlines, budgets and business decisions organized.

 - Coordinate internal information and keep leadership informed with clear recommendations and next steps.

 - Know when a matter needs specialist advice and make sure the right lawyer has what they need.


FINANCINGS & CAPITAL MARKETS

 - Manage legal work for fundraising, credit facilities and capital-markets transactions with Finance and outside counsel.

 - Keep closing checklists, approvals and follow-up obligations current so work does not fall between teams.


COMMERCIAL & PARTNERSHIPS

 - Draft and negotiate partnership, vendor and other commercial agreements with terms that support the business and protect its downside.

 - Build practical templates, negotiation guidance and approval rules that make routine work faster and more consistent.

 - Help business owners understand their commitments before signing and carry them through afterward.


REGULATORY

 - Coordinate advice on card programs, bank partnerships and consumer-finance questions with compliance colleagues and specialist counsel.

 - Keep applicable obligations, evidence requirements and escalation paths clear as products and partnerships develop.


EMPLOYMENT & CONTRACTORS

 - Review contractor and consulting agreements, offer letters, confidentiality terms and IP protections with People and outside employment counsel.

 - Identify gaps in existing agreements, agree a practical repair plan and follow it through.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - A JD and active New York or California bar admission, with authority to practice in the work location confirmed before starting.

 - Substantial legal experience, typically eight or more years, with hands-on ownership in fintech or another regulated business.

 - Strong commercial drafting and negotiation skills, including the ability to offer workable alternatives.

 - Experience managing outside counsel, budgets and complex matters through completion.

 - Familiarity with card programs, bank relationships, consumer finance, credit facilities or fundraising.

 - Clear, direct communication and good judgment about when to escalate.

 - Discretion with sensitive information and a willingness to surface difficult facts early.

 - The ability to prioritize and follow through without an internal team or constant direction.

 


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Leadership trusts you to run legal work independently and bring clear decisions when needed.

 - Outside counsel works to clear scopes, budgets and deadlines.

 - Business teams have useful templates and straightforward guidance for negotiations and approvals.

 - Contractor and consulting terms are current, consistent and properly documented.

 - Financing work moves through agreed milestones, with closing and ongoing obligations tracked.

 - Regulatory and bank-partner reviews are prepared, with clear owners and follow-through.

 


COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is $240,000–$290,000, plus equity.

jobs.title: Brigádnik/Brigádnička, Levice OC Dituria
jobs.description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Brigádnik/Brigádnička v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
• Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
• Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
• Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
• A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
• Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

• Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
• Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
• Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.
• Majú viac ako 18 rokov
• Sú flexibilní a môžu pracovať na popoludňajších zmenách

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
• Rozsiahly program školení,
• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
• Občerstvenie na pracovisku.

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​ ​

Ide o pozíciu na dohodu s miestom výkonu práce v Leviciach. Typ mimopracovnoprávneho vzťahu bude upresnený v priebehu náborového procesu.

Platové ohodnotenie vo výške 6,12 € za hodinu.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 27.11.2026. Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na  recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

Viac informácií o tom, ako spracúvame vaše osobné údaje, nájdete v našich Zásadách ochrany osobných údajov.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From assistant manager to general manager, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

· For short distances for short durations

· Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

· During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

· During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

· Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

· Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

· Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

· Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

· Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

· Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager (05727) - 111 Willow Lane Suite #9
jobs.description:
Overview:

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you have always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance, Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically Assistant Managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills- judgement, math and the ability to multi-task.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Assistant managers are responsible for everything that happens during the shift. This includes cost control, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You set the tone and the example for the store and you have to be on your game 100% of the time!

Your job responsibilities would include (but are not limited to):

• Perform all the duties of the Customer Services Representatives and Delivery Drivers.
• Manage anywhere from 3 to 30 employees during your scheduled shift.
• Responsible for all store operations.
• Greeting customers and taking orders with a smile (yes, you even have to smile when you answer the phone)!
• Operating the cash register and collecting payment from customers.
• Making fast, accurate and consistent products while complying with all portion sizes, recipes and baking procedures.
• Delivering product by vehicle from the store to the customer in a safe and courteous manner.
• Maintaining cleanliness of the restaurant from the first thing the customer sees all the way to the back of the store.
• Maintain a professional appearance at all times in compliance within the Domino's Pizza Grooming Standards.

What are we looking for?

The good news is we can teach you how to answer the phone and make a perfect pizza. But here are a few skills you should have to be a successful Assistant Manager:

• Experience leading a team; during your shift, you will manage a staff of anywhere from 3 to 30 people. You will need to use your stellar attitude and motivational skills to get them in the right place, at the right time and doing the right thing all while creating a great place to work.
• A clean driving record and the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Record check. Safety is a priority for us and we want to make sure anyone we put on the road is safe to be there. You will also need access to reliable vehicle that is insured and have a valid driver's license
• A great role model - you're the person everyone will look to. From being on time for your shift, to having a great attitude to customers and co-workers and even how you dress - you have to have high standards for yourself and the rest of the team.
• Our stores are open 365 days a week. Yes, that's right even on the weekends and the holidays; that's when we are busiest! While you schedule is pretty flexible, you have to be willing to work when the team needs you the most.
• You have to be at least 18 years old.

You'll be working for a company that is fun and flexible. Not to mention, its work experience you will rely on for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now it's time to help up be the pizza delivery company in the world. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. We offer weekly pay. Apply now!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

Talking and hearing on telephone.

Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

Depth perception.

Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tilebricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24- 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Additional Job Details

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.

Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.

Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.

Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
jobs.description:
About Tempo

Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C.

Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures.

For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com.

We are seeking a resourceful and highly organized Executive Assistant and Office Administrator to join our rapidly growing startup. As we develop thermochemical energy storage systems across our engineering and research facilities, we need someone who can keep our leadership team and our day-to-day operations running smoothly.

This is a vital, multi-faceted role. You will serve as the administrative engine for our leadership team, own the systems that keep our office running, and act as the face of the company at the front desk. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing complex international travel, scheduling high-priority meetings, and making a strong first impression on investors, board members, and candidates walking through the door.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Support

• Provide direct administrative support to the leadership team, including managing calendars, proactively scheduling internal and external meetings, and resolving scheduling conflicts with sound judgment on priorities.

• Coordinate complex domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries.

• Support board and investor logistics, including meeting preparation, materials coordination, and visitor arrangements.

• Handle sensitive and confidential information with consistent discretion.

• Coordinate meeting logistics, including physical and virtual room booking and required technology.

Front Desk and Hospitality

• Serve as the primary point of contact for all visitors and deliveries, maintaining a professional, organized, and welcoming reception area and directing guests to the appropriate host.

• Own the ordering and coordination of catering for office lunches, team events, board meetings, and daily executive meal orders.

• Manage mailroom duties, receiving and sending G&A-related mail and packages (excluding production and manufacturing shipments).

Office and Facilities

• Keep the office and breakroom fully stocked by proactively monitoring and ordering office supplies, snacks, coffee, and beverages while ensuring cost-effective purchasing.

• Act as the main point of contact for our cleaning crew and other facility vendors to ensure the office and common spaces are maintained to a high standard.

• Oversee maintenance for all office equipment, including printers and copiers.

• Keep storage areas clean and organized and ensure general office supplies are always accessible to employees.

• Support company events and team-building activities, owning each one from kickoff to completion, including budget, logistics, and other critical moving pieces.

Requirements/Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as an executive assistant or in a senior administrative role, preferably within a startup or technical environment.

• Demonstrated experience managing executive calendars and coordinating complex domestic and international travel.

• Proven ability to manage a busy front desk while staying focused on detailed administrative work.

• Sound judgment and consistent discretion when handling confidential information.

• Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail across scheduling, inventory management, and office upkeep.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with investors, board members, and staff.

• High proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office Suite, and Slack, with experience using cloud-based platforms and services.

• A self-starter who identifies needs before they become problems and works well with minimal supervision.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field preferred.

Physical Demands

• Sitting and standing: Extended periods at a desk performing computer-based administrative work, balanced with time at the front desk greeting visitors and moving throughout the office.

• Lifting and carrying: Ability to lift and carry packages, supply deliveries, and catering orders up to 25 lbs.

• Mobility: Regular movement throughout the office, breakroom, storage areas, and mailroom to restock supplies and support events.

• Travel: Occasional local travel for supply or catering pickup and event support.

Compensation Range

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $68,000 to $82,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, location, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity or benefits.

Working at Tempo

Tempo is a lean organization working on exciting challenges, and the people who thrive here share a few things in common beyond their technical skills.

• Clear, direct communication: You professionally say what you mean, lead with empathy, use tact, ask when you're unsure, and keep the people around you informed without being asked. At a company our size, communication gaps are expensive, and good communicators add to success and efficiency!

• Low-ego helpfulness: You're willing to jump in on work that isn't strictly yours, whether that's helping a teammate debug something, lending a hand in the shop, or flagging an issue you noticed outside your lane. No one here succeeds in a silo.

• Intellectual curiosity: You're genuinely interested in how things work, not just your piece of it, but the broader system. Tempo sits at the intersection of chemistry, mechanical engineering, power electronics, and software; the more you understand about the whole, the more valuable you become.

• Business awareness: You understand that your work exists in a business context. You think about cost, timeline, and tradeoffs—not just technical elegance—and you make decisions accordingly.

• Comfort with ambiguity: Processes here are still being built. You can make progress without a perfect playbook, and you know when to ask for direction versus when to use your judgment and move forward.

• Accountability: You own your outcomes, including the misses. When something goes sideways, the instinct here is to fix it and learn from it, not to explain why it wasn't your fault.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards as well as access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery. You should possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members

· Operate all equipment.

· Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.

· Prepare product.

· Receive and process telephone orders.

· Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.

· Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

For short distances for short durations

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies.

A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Driving Specific Job Duties

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.

Deliver flyers and door hangers.

Requires

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.

Access to insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Wage Rates

All inside positions start at minimum wage and raises are given upon completion of training evaluations completed by team member and manager. For assistants this ranges from $15.95-$18.26. Monthly bonuses are offered if criteria and responsibilities are met- they are not guaranteed.

Medical, Dental and Vision insurance are available to employees who have worked at least a year and who average at least 32 hours per week. If you have any questions about Benefits Qualifications, please contact HR@hamiltonholdings.net.

We abide by OR State requirements for sick pay.

Hours: All scheduled hours are based off what employee is available for and what the store needs. All positions are part time unless otherwise stated. Every employee has the opportunity to work into full time as long as the store has the hours to accommodate by completing training, being reliable for shifts and communicating full time needs with manager.

This store is currently not hiring, but nearby locations are looking for a a prospective employee to train to be a full time shift lead with open availability who is also able to close. Shifts are typically 5pm-2:30am this can be earlier or later depending on how sales of the day were handled.

Communication Skills

· Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

· Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

· Ability to communicate and interact respectfully and effectively with people across cultures, abilities, genders, ethnicities, and races.

Essential Functions/Skills

· Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).

· Must be able to make correct monetary change.

· Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.

· Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

· Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.

· Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.

· In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.

· Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

· Fumes from food odors.

· Exposure to cornmeal dust.

· Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.

· Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.

· Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

· Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

· Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.

· Depth perception.

· Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

· Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.  Willingness to jump in and perform any job necessary.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Walking

· For short distances for short durations. Walking or Standing most of shift besides breaks.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting

· Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

· Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

· Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

· Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

· Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

· To move trays which are placed on dollies.

· A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24" - 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

· Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

· Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

· Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.

· Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.

· Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.

·Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

·Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

· Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.

· Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.

· Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.

· Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

· Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day

· Frequently activities require use of one or both hands. Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.

· Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.· Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.

· Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

·Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

jobs.description:
Looking for a job where you get to listen to your own music? Spend time in your own car driving, while making tips AND a wage? Domino's Pizza is looking for Delivery drivers who are at least 18 Years of age, and have 2 or more years of driving history. Looking to hire great attitudes :) Willing to train you on the rest.

Part time available, with flexible schedules. Paid mileage and tips at the end of every shift. Make between 18-26 an hour!

Benefits of working at Domino's Pizza:

• Fun working environment
• Flexible schedules
• Competitive wages PLUS GENEROUS TIPS AND MILEAGE REIMBURSEMENT
• Store discounts
• Free uniform shirt and hat
• Full Time employees are eligible for health benefits in only SIX months!

Currently looking for Drivers who can work the Rush/Late/CLOSING shifts.

Qualifications:

• Valid DL
• Minimum of 2 years of verifiable driving experience
• Consistent work history
• Ability to successfully meet company compliance requirements with regards to MVR, DOT, CSA and/or Criminal Background
• Food and/or Beverage transport experience, a plus
• Ability to lift 20 lbs on a frequent basis
• Ability to safely maneuver the vehicle in close quarters and heavily congested traffic areas

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

PLEASE READ BELOW

Driving History

All persons must meet the following requirements in order to operate a motor vehicle for business purposes including, but not limited to, making deliveries:

• A person who is 18 years of age must possess proof of at least two years of driving history immediately preceding the date of the MVR evaluation.
• A person who is 19 years of age must possess proof of at least one year of driving history immediately preceding the date of the MVR evaluation.
• A learner’s permit period documented by an appropriate governmental authority may only be used to confirm driving history. We do not accept drivers who do not have an officially stated liscense.

DRIVING RECORD

All persons must meet the following requirements in order to operate a motor vehicle for business purposes including, but not limited to, making deliveries:

• No more than two driving-related violations (such as speeding, failure to yield, failure to obey traffic signals, careless driving, failure to wear a seatbelt,) in the two years immediately preceding the date of the MVR.
• No more than three driving related violations in the three years immediately preceding the date off the MVR.
• No more than one at fault accident in the three years preceding the date of the MVR.

If a person has any of the following violations they will be unable to driver for Domino’s.

• Leaving the scene of an accident.
• Hit and Run
• Reckless Driving
• Any driving violations involving drugs or alcohol.
• Vehicular homicide or assault
• Unlawful Racing and Exhibition Driving
• Eluding or Attempting to Allude an officer.

jobs.title: Senior Executive and Equity Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
The Senior Analyst, Executive and Equity Compensation supports the administration and governance of executive compensation programs, including equity plan administration, compensation consultation for Director-level and above positions, and compensation analysis and modeling. The role develops accurate, timely, and decision-ready analyses, reports, and materials that support executive compensation programs, governance processes, and business success. This position also supports Compensation Discussion and Analysis disclosures and Compensation and Human Capital Committee materials, while partnering across Total Rewards, Payroll, Legal, Finance, Accounting, external equity administration vendors, and compensation consultants.

What You’ll Do

• Administer equity compensation programs by coordinating and validating grants, vesting, releases, settlements, forfeitures, cancellations, and participant record activities to support accurate and timely plan execution.
• Perform recurring reconciliations, audits, and data-quality reviews across equity administration, HR, Payroll, Finance, and Accounting records; investigate and resolve discrepancies.
• Coordinate international equity tax reviews for participants with cross-border work activity or mobility events, partnering with Payroll, Tax, HR, Legal, and external vendors to validate sourcing, tax withholding, reporting requirements, and participant data related to vesting and settlement events.
• Maintain procedures, calendars, controls, documentation, approval records, confidential records, process documentation, and record-retention materials supporting equity transactions, compliance, reporting, audits, and reviews.
• Prepare participant communications, respond to equity plan inquiries, and escalate legal, tax, accounting, or policy matters to the appropriate subject-matter experts.
• Provide compensation consultation and analytical support for Director-level and above positions, including new hires, promotions, retention actions, organizational changes, and other compensation decisions.
• Conduct executive market benchmarking using compensation surveys, proxy disclosures, and other applicable market sources; support survey submissions, data validation, internal equity reviews, market-competitiveness assessments, and pay-for-performance analysis across base salary, annual incentive, long-term incentive, total cash, and total direct compensation.
• Prepare compensation analyses, pay recommendations, financial models, summaries, and presentations that translate complex data into concise findings, risks, alternatives, and recommendations for Total Rewards leadership and business or HR stakeholders.
• Partner with external compensation consultants on executive benchmarking, peer group analysis, program reviews, and other executive compensation matters.
• Support preparation of the annual proxy statement Compensation Discussion and Analysis and Compensation and Human Capital Committee materials by gathering, calculating, validating, documenting, and quality-checking data, analyses, exhibits, presentations, and supporting documentation.
• Monitor executive and equity compensation practices, regulatory developments, governance expectations, and market trends; summarize potential implications and identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, data quality, reporting, stakeholder experience, and vendor service delivery.
• Support compensation projects and recurring processes while balancing multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders during peak equity, committee, and proxy cycles.

What You’ll Bring

In addition to the technical and functional requirements of this role, successful candidates demonstrate Domino's Hungry for MORE Ways of Working:

Be Curious

• Seeks clarity, asks thoughtful questions, and uncovers root causes to solve problems effectively.
• Actively pursues learning opportunities, applies feedback, and continuously develops new skills.

Connect the Dots

• Uses information and insights to identify opportunities and drive informed decisions.
• Builds strong partnerships across teams and considers the broader organizational impact of decisions.

Aim High

• Sets ambitious goals, challenges the status quo, and focuses on work that drives meaningful business results.
• Uses feedback and data to continuously improve performance and outcomes.

Shift Fast

• Adapts quickly to changing priorities and business needs while maintaining focus on results.
• Demonstrates resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to learn from setbacks.

Deliver More

• Takes ownership, executes with discipline, and consistently produces measurable results.
• Identifies opportunities to create additional value for customers, team members, and the business.

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Typically requires 3 to 5 years of compensation, Total Rewards, HR analytics, Finance, or closely related experience.
• Strong knowledge of compensation principles, including market pricing, job evaluation, salary structures, incentive compensation, internal equity, and pay governance. Experience in equity administration preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to interpret compensation survey data and develop market-aligned recommendations.
• Advanced Excel skills required, including experience with complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and large data sets.
• Experience with HRIS, compensation planning tools, survey platforms, or reporting tools preferred.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain compensation concepts to non-compensation audiences.
• Ability to handle sensitive and confidential employee and compensation information with discretion.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. jobs.title: Assistant Manager(07744) - 1621 W. Chapman Ave.
jobs.description:
You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance - Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you'll need some skills - judgment, math and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's fun and flexible. Not to mention, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and Customer relations. You must set the example. You must follow ALL policy and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew.

In addition: Staffing, Paperwork, Cost Controls, Cash control, Food management, Work to a Schedule, Perfect Image and adherence to standards, Great Customer Service, Attendance & punctuality, Transportation to/from work, Store cleanliness, Marketing, Profitability.

PAY

Starts at $21 per hour, up to $24 per hour depending on skill level.

QUALIFICATIONS

• General job duties for all store team members
• Operate all equipment. Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
• Prepare product.
• Receive and process telephone orders.
• Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.
• Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

TRAINING

• Orientation and training provided on the job.
• Management-specific training providedBusiness managing skillsPeople managing skills

COMMUNICATION SKILLS

• Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.
• Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/SKILLS

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
• Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.
• Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
• Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.
• In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.
• Fumes from food odors.
• Exposure to cornmeal dust.
• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.
• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
• Depth perception.
• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

• Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

• For short distances for short durations.
• Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

• Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

• Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

• Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
• Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

• Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines

EPL Pizza, Inc. will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act. You do not need to disclose your criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if EPL Pizza, Inc. is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. Find out more about the Fair Chance Act by visiting the Civil Right’s Department Fair Chance Act webpage.

Of course, you'll need skills – sound judgment, business acumen, empathy, people management insight and the ability to multitask.

You'll be working for a company that's at the forefront of the Quick Service Restaurant industry, with a benefits package to match! As an Operating Partner you will have the opportunity to run a $1-2 million business, with the safety net of a 43-store franchise. This is work experience you're going to use for a long time to come, ideally growing within the operation to ultimately guide and develop future Operating Partners, or perhaps franchise on your own. If that's not for you, consider this an ideal opportunity to learn the ins and outs of the Quick Service Restaurant industry, navigating labor costs, food costs, waste management, people management, and mastering the service industry. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now help us be the best in pizza delivery. Go on, big shot, show us what you've got.

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first! Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an empathetic environment where all team members are valued for their differences and encouraged to reach their highest potential. If this sounds like a culture you want to be a part of and lead, what are you waiting for? Apply!

Duties & Responsibilities: Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control and customer relations. You are the leader – so set the example! You must follow ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your crew. Additionally, you have the opportunity to lead a team toward a common, outstanding goal: sell more pizzas, have more fun, and make more dough! In doing so, you will be responsible for staffing, paperwork submission, food management, scheduling, maintaining image standards, store cleanliness, marketing, and profitability. Additional requirements and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

• Ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, coordinate with coworkers and customers, analyze and compile data, make sound, ethical judgments and decisions in a timely manner.
• Enthusiastic customer greeting and positive personality – taking orders and fielding customer concerns with a smile!
• Operate, clean, and maintain all store facility and equipment.

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
• Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Comfortability utilizing a computer keyboard, touch screen, and foot-paddle.

Benefits:

• Opportunity to hone leadership and managerial skills for future business use
• Learn the ins and outs of the Quick Service Restaurant industry - including managing food cost, labor cost, wage considerations, interviewing, people management, and the opportunity to manage a $1 million business
• Competitive salary structure (base + monthly bonus)

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General job duties for all store team members

• Operate all equipment.
• Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
• Prepare product.
• Receive and process telephone orders.

• Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.
• Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions. Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the

phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
• Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.
• Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
• Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.
• In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.

• Fumes from food odors.
• Exposure to cornmeal dust.
• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.
• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
• Depth perception.

• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing: Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking: For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
• Workers reach above 72"occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

Daily tasks are performed from a standing position, as such you will be on your feet for majority of your shift. This role includes, but is not limited to, the following activities:

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you?
